bartholomew gallows.name: Bartholomew Gallows
bartholomew gallows.origin: Bartholomew Gallows became the vigilante "Americop" after resigning from the Houston Police when he became disillusioned with the judicial system and felt the process was too ineffective. He listened to security scanners around Houston, and then tracked down criminals and wrongdoers. He had an encounter with Captain America, who was appalled and condemned Americop's brutalities, and tried to stop him while they both were trying to capture munitions magnate Damon Dran. The two were knocked out by a gas grenade and imprisoned but later escaped. Americop killed many of Dran's men, and thought that Dran died in a helicopter explosion. After the Civil War, Americop was listed as a potential recruit for the Initiative by S.H.I.E.L.D.. However, he became a target on the Thunderbolts' "Most Wanted" files. Norman Osborn sent Bullseye and Penance to catch Americop, hoping that the vigilante would kill them both or at least toughen Penance up. During the hunt Penance let out a powerful energy blast (caused by Bullseye) that injured Gallows, who was taken bleeding to Thunderbolts Mountain and was later determined to be paralyzed. Gallows eventually died (possibly as a result of the wounds incurred during his fight with the Thunderbolts) and his costume and code name were appropriated by Keane Industries for their private policing initiative, the Americops.

bartholomew grice.name: Bartholomew Grice
bartholomew grice.origin: Bartholomew was one of the many young mutants enrolled in the Xavier Institute after it went public. During the time Wolverine had been brainwashed to serve Hydra, Bartholomew was one of the many students herded into the school's panic room by Kitty Pryde. He asked Kitty if he could leave the room to use the bathroom, and was refused. It is believed he lost his powers following M-Day and was most likely killed when the bus exploded.

bartholomew ingrid.name: Bartholomew Ingrid
bartholomew ingrid.origin: Bart Ingrid and Jack Monroe grew up in the small town of Clutier, Iowa. When they were children, Jack bullied Bart Ingrid, often calling him Ingrid Bergman. He never forgave Jack for inadvertently revealing the town was full of Nazis. Later in his life, he becomes a U.S. Senator and supports a White Supremacist camp outside of Clutier. He hired Zaran to kill Jack Monroe. Jack later slaughters the entire camp, revealing Ingrid's connections. Ingrid is killed when Jack shoots him with the super soldier gun.

bartholomew jones.name: Bartholomew Jones
bartholomew jones.origin: Bart Jones is Firestar's father. Bart's mother helped him care for his daughter. After she died and Angelica revealed she was a mutant, he sent her to the Massachusetts Academy where she became the White Queen's student. Eventually, Firestar left the Academy and moved back home. In time she joined the New Warriors. Bart revealed to Angel that he knew she was Firestar and accepted her and her teammate and boyfriend at Vance Astrovik's murder trial for killing his own abusive father. Firestar was devastated when Vance was sent to jail. Months later, a street gang with a grudge against the New Warriors attacked and kidnapped several members of the New Warriors' families. Bart Jones was shot, and Firestar rushed him to the hospital. At some point during Bart's recuperation, Angel's boyfriend Vance was paroled and lived with Bart and Angel. Bart had tried to get Vance's mother to forgive Vance for the killing of her husband, but she refused. Vance eventually moved out of Bart's home and moved in with his (platonic) teammate Namorita. When Richard Rider was being chased by Nova Omega, he visited Bart Jones to see if he could find Firestar, but she was elsewhere.

bartholomew trask.species: Metamutant ( and Bolivar Trask were combined in a Marvel versus DC crossover)
bartholomew trask.origin: At a convention of marshals and sheriffs, Marshal "Bat" Trask, the self-proclaimed "foremost malform hunter this side of Little Rock, Arkansas", unveiled his newly created robotic Razormen to an unsuspecting crowd. When the band of malform outlaws known as Generation Hex attempted to rob a mail train, Trask was waiting for them on board the train with his Razormen hidden in the boxcars. Hoping for a malform-free West, Trask sent his Razormen after Generation Hex to hunt down and destroy the malforms. What Masrhal Trask did not know or perhaps knew only on a subconscious level was that the genius that enabled him to design the Razormen came from a subtle mutation of his own brain. The Razormen relentlessly pursued Generation Hex for days. But before the robots were able to destroy their targets, Generation Hex tricked the Razormen into slaughtering the non-malform inhabitants of the town of Humanity instead.

bartin culp.name: Bartin Culp
bartin culp.origin: Not much is known of the past of Bartin Culp of Earth-4096. In the year 2300 AD, he was a member of the Space Rangers, a group of law enforcement officers that defended outer space. He earned the nickname "Nibbs," and he was partnered with Bob Raleigh. They have had two recorded adventures together. In the first of them, they investigated a series of robberies on merchant ships. They noted that they had their supplies of Plinium stolen. This plot was carried out by Blackhawk from the asteroid near Mercury. Tracking the thefts to that location, the Space Rangers investigated the place and were captured. They broke free with the help of Blackhawk's daughter Alyse, and destroyed Blackhawk's ship, killing him. In their second adventure, following the disappearance of a series of experimental ships, the Space Rangers were sent in to investigate. They were captured by Carl Formes of the planet Glakor. They were tossed into the pit of a dragon, but managed to break free and slay the creature. They destroyed the device that Formes has used to capture the ships, but their enemy locked himself up in a safe room that has enough supplies to keep him alive for a year. With no way of getting at their enemy, the Rangers found a stockpile of explosives and set them to go off, destroying the entire planet.

baru.name: Baru
baru.origin: The king of Canaan, Baru was deposed when Moses Magnum conquered the country. Baru was rejected by his people and exiled himself to Wakanda, where alchemist Diablo turned him into a creature made of Vibranium - Diablo intended to transform Monica Lynne like that, but Baru volunteered for the experiment to protect her. Baru retained his mind and will, but was unable to return to his previous shape, and decided to live in the Wakandan wilderness as a mythical being of sorts.

basallo.name: Basallo
basallo.origin: Basallo was the King of the Lava Men. Once, he sent their supreme warrior, Molto, to the surface world to see if they were a threat to the subterranean Lava Men, where he was manipulated by Loki to clash with Thor. A short time later, an explosion from deep within the Earth rocked the realm of the Lava Men, as the Living Rock forced into it. The Lava Men learned that the Living Rock would generate explosive force when struck, and that it would continue to grow in size until it exploded. Jinku, the witch doctor of the Lava Men, counseled the King to build a machine and drive the Living Rock to the surface world where it would destroy the surface of the planet instead. Despite Molto's protests, the King agreed and followed Jinku's recommendations. This brought them into a conflict with the Avengers, which ended when the Avengers duped the Hulk into striking the Living Rock in the one spot that would destroy it. With the threat over, the Avengers convinced the Lava Men to not invade the surface, and the Lava Men returned to Subterranea. Some time later, Basallo was convinced by Jinku to steal the Mole Man's volcano-activating machine from the Moloids, as well as stealing Mjolnir from Thor.

basar.name: Basar
basar.origin: The demon named Basar was the son of Kthara, who was trapped in a tomb in Colma and was guarded by a demonic Keeper. Trapped in the body of Victoria, a patient in the Saint Teresa Center for Mental Health, his mother arranged for a nurse Keith Spivey to remove the Keeper's skull, enabling Basar to possess Spivey's body. After that body was eventually destroyed, Kthara arranged for Basar to possess Daimon Helstrom, but he was eventually exorcised by Daimon's sister Ana Helstrom.

basenji.name: Basenji
basenji.origin: A genetics genius from Europe who studies at E.S.U in New York. She, and the rest of the foreign exchange students who make up The Litter, wish to genetically engineer mankind so that they are more like dogs, presumably having originally genetically engineered themselves. She grows larger and more muscled, gaining brown fur and other characteristics of dogs as she transforms. Captain Britain, while drunk, hits her too hard, and she hits a wall and gets a severely sprained back, which causes the fight to stop immediately. She is taken away in an ambulance, and Brian Braddock secretly pays for her hospital bills and rehab.

bash street bunty.name: Bash Street Bunty
bash street bunty.origin: When the insane reality-warping mutant Mad Jim Jaspers took over the government of the Great Britain of Earth-238. Mad Jim Jaspers began persecuting other costumed paranormal individuals, having them hunted down and executed in order to make Britain a more safer place to live. After they became outlawed fugitives she joined the fight against the oppressive regime running Britain and was among the group that were hiding in a secret location when the Fury attacked and began slaughtering everyone there. Other people slaughtered by the Fury are, Kid Miracleman, Iron Tallon, the Crusader, Gaath, the Puppetman, Captain Roy Risk, the Arachnid, Android Andy, Tom Rosetta, Miracleman, Colonel Tusker, and Young Miracleman. Captain UK was the only surviving hero on that day thanks to her husband, Rick, sending her away in a Ghost Box. His remains were buried in a superhero graveyard, and years later Captain Britain passed by her tombstone.

basil crushstone.name: Basil Crushstone
basil crushstone.origin: Basil Crushstone was a deposed African dictator who took control of the mind of Queen Elizabeth II, intending to have her command the British Armed Forces to help him reclaim the country of Umbazi. However, his plan was thwarted by Captain Britain. Crushstone appeared to die when the plane he was attempting to escape in crashed into the sea, Inspector Dai Thomas having drained its fuel tanks without his knowledge.

basil drake.origin: Basil Drake was a wealthy Englishman seeking to marry Ellen Chadwick, the daughter of Sir John Chadwick. When he was refused he became insane with rage at this denial. Utilizing an invisibility potion of his own invention, he doused his Ethiopian aide Chandi with the solution to render his entire body except for his hands invisible. Chandi would then be dispatched to murder individual members of the Chadwick family. Sir John feared for his family and contacted his American colleague Professor Philo Zog who came to his friend's aid along with his robot invention Electro. Electro and the Professor sent the mostly invisible attacker fleeing into the night and tracked him back to Drake's home. Drake unleashed a horde of captured apes upon the robot, but they proved no match for it. Strangling the invisible Chandi into submission, Zog piloted Electro into Drake's bed room too late to stop him from committing suicide to prevent himself from having to face Electro alone. Chandi attacked Zog and his friends after and was shot dead.

basil frankenstein.name: Basil Frankenstein
basil frankenstein.origin: Basil Frankenstein was a Nazi scientist and the descendant of Victor Frankenstein, the creator of the Frankenstein's Monster, through Victor's brother Ernst. In 1942, Basil collaborated with a Japanese scientist named Doctor Kitagowa and used his ancestor's research to create an undead army for the Third Reich. His research led to creating his own monster; Basil ensured to have the monster loyal to his creator unlike the original monster. Basil's activities caught the notice of the Invaders and had his monster subduing and securing the heroes at Castle Frankenstein. The Invaders soon broke free and fought the monster a second time. During the battle, the creature was slammed into an electrical panel and the massive jolt of electricity disrupted the programming that forced him to be obedient to his masters. Basil, along with Kitagowa, faced the wrath of the freed monster in which he grabbed them and threw himself and his creators from the parapet of the castle, plunging to their deaths.

basil kilgrew.name: Basil Kilgrew
basil kilgrew.origin: Basil Kilgrew was an employee of Department H's Floor 13. There, he was designated as Beta 1 and in charge of several projects. Projects he was involved with included the extraction of DNA from the captured Woodgod, monitoring the genetic development of several members of Alpha Flight, the development of semi-organic synthoids known as Beta Flight and some knowledge of the development of the new Weapon X. Basil's wife and son were completely unaware of Basil's career as he signed an all-encompassing security and secrecy agreement. Basil, despite the considerable risk, chose to reveal some of the more clandestine and illicit projects of Department H to the Alphan Puck. He did so by slipping him some documents, including one referring to a failed "Legacy," Cleric. Basil was finally able to amass a large amount of data on Beta Flight, Hull House and all of the Department's illegal and immoral bio-tech experiments to expose the Department. Basil planned to send Puck the file, leave early for the day and take his family to another country, beyond Department H's grasp. He sent the file, entitled Curiosity, and left for the day, but there was a flaw in his plan. Earlier that morning, his son, not even old enough yet to read, had looked at some of his papers. Basil had ignored it since no one else knew. But the Department knew. His house was being monitored. The incident with his son was seen. Basil Kilgrew died due to an "accidental" elevator failure, leading to a crash at the bottom of the shaft.

basilio rez.name: Basilio Rez
basilio rez.origin: Basilio Rez used a messenger to force the bandits into battle against the warband gathered by the leaders of Kyof's Grove. He performed a ritual to hoard life essences bonded by gold, in order to conjure Walking Thorntrees, one of which was burned by Vessila. He was defeated when Conan threw a crucible against him, which shattered the scrying glass and poured molten gold on tinder-dry wood, freeing the trapped life essences and the Spirits of the Trees.

bask.name: Bask
bask.origin: 10,000 years ago, Wakanda was constantly attacked by the Atlantean invaders. On one occasion, Bask and her twin brother Olumo were fighting against two Atlanteans when they fell into a cave where they found an unknown ore. They explored the cave and she touched a powerful core that corrupted her, but her brother separated her. They both left and the core was placed in Wakanda. She tried again to seize the core, but her brother again prevented her. An Atlantean attack ensued and fed up with the Atlanteans seized the core to destroy them. She destroyed the Atlantean stronghold forcing them to flee and her brother tried in vain to stop her. King T'Challa, who revived Bashenga's memories, was dragged into the dimension within the crown. He was attacked by Bask, but, together with Captain America, they escaped the dimension and Bask mysteriously appeared at the burial place of the Wakandan kings.

basque.name: Basque
basque.origin: Basque was one of the last four Followers of the Light on Earth. He was a member of the Lumina race even though he and generations of his ancestors had been born on Earth. Like their ancestors, Basque and his fellow Followers acted as sentinels against the possible return of their ancient enemies, the Myndai sorcerer-scientist Lord Maur-Kon and his Dark Agents, who had been trapped in suspended animation since the end of the Great Chaos Wars millennia ago. When a volcanic eruption in the early 21st century caused their enemies to finally awaken, Basque and the other Followers summoned the three humans who their computers had determined would be the best pilots of the Shogun Warrior robots. With the other Followers, Basque provided support to these three Agents of the Light as they used the Shogun Warriors to battle and defeat various monsters sent against them, first by Lord Maur-Kon and, later, by Doctor Demonicus. Basque and the other three Followers died when a giant alien monster attacked Shogun Sanctuary. The Agents of the Light arrived in their Shogun Warriors too late to save them but were able to kill the monster when it attacked them. The Agents then buried the bodies of the Followers in graves marked with ankhs on a mountaintop overlooking the ruins of Sanctuary. A month later, the Agents of the Light and the Fantastic Four confronted the alien Primal One who had sent the monster that killed the Followers. During the battle, the Primal One was revealed to be nothing more than a high-tech avatar that Maur-Kon was using to conceal his identity. Once exposed, Maur-Kon was swiftly defeated and taken into custody by the Charter Federation forces that his false Primal One had summoned, under false pretenses, to help him destroy the Shogun Warriors.

basqus.name: Basqus
basqus.origin: Dom Castillio was the captain of the ship West Wolf, a buccaneer in the service of the King of Zingara. He stormed the Barachans pirate ship and captured Conan. While Dom Castillio questioned him, Conan revealed to him that he recognized him as Basqus the Butcher who in the past had made a massacre in the province of Hispan but being useful to the king, he made him change his name and put him in his service. Castillio forced Conan to reveal to him where Captain Bloodraven's treasure was, but arriving on the island where the treasure was, all of Castillio's men were killed in an ambush by the natives. Castillio managed to escape but was joined by Conan who had managed to free himself in the turmoil, and after being defeated by Conan, Castillio revealed by sincerely opening that everything he had done, including the search for the treasure, he was doing for his family. Conan helped Castillio find the treasure, defeating various dangers and traps on the island together, eventually sharing the jewel-encrusted necklace with Conan who left Castillio with a warning that it would all depend on how he behaved in the future before parting.

bat harper.name: Bat (Harper)
bat harper.origin: The Rawhide Kid entered into a town that had been plagued by a series of bank robberies by a masked man known only as the Bat. When people recognized the Rawhide Kid, who was a wanted outlaw, many believed him to be the Bat. The Rawhide Kid, in fact, was only looking for a bank to deposit his money and therefore sought out the owner of the local bank, a Mr. Harper. Harper, however, refused to take the money of an outlaw and his wife, daughter, and soon to be son-in-law, Seth Wilson, berated the Kid for his behaviour. Later, determined to leave town and find another place to deposit his money, the Kid witnessed the Bat robbing the town's bank and took off after him in order to clear his name. The Bat fled as fast as his horse could ride towards the foothills outside of town until his horse tripped and fell. The Bat scrambled onto his feet and began climbing up the hillside away from the pursuing Rawhide Kid. The Bat was in such a mad scramble that he failed to see a mountain lion that was above him until it pounced, sending both the Bat and the cat over the side of a cliff. The Kid then went to the Bat to see if he had survived the fall and was shocked to learn that the Bat was, in fact, Mr. Harper himself. Harper then confessed that his bank had been losing money and that he had been been stealing in order to cover up the losses. After confessing, Mr. Harper passed away. Seth Wilson witnessed the whole thing and apologized to the Kid. The Kid, however, told him to tell the people in town that he was in fact the Bat and that Mr. Harper had given his life to save the bank's money, chasing him in order to save the man's reputation.

Harper, however, refused to take the money of an outlaw and his wife, daughter, and soon to be son-in-law, Seth Wilson, berated the Kid for his behaviour. Later, determined to leave town and find another place to deposit his money, the Kid witnessed the Bat robbing the town's bank and took off after him in order to clear his name. The Bat fled as fast as his horse could ride towards the foothills outside of town until his horse tripped and fell. The Bat scrambled onto his feet and began climbing up the hillside away from the pursuing Rawhide Kid. The Bat was in such a mad scramble that he failed to see a mountain lion that was above him until it pounced, sending both the Bat and the cat over the side of a cliff. The Kid then went to the Bat to see if he had survived the fall and was shocked to learn that the Bat was, in fact, Mr. Harper himself. Harper then confessed that his bank had been losing money and that he had been been stealing in order to cover up the losses. After confessing, Mr. Harper passed away. Seth Wilson witnessed the whole thing and apologized to the Kid. The Kid, however, told him to tell the people in town that he was in fact the Bat and that Mr. Harper had given his life to save the bank's money, chasing him in order to save the man's reputation.
weapons: He was armed with pistols.

bathala.name: Bathala
bathala.species: One of the three primary Diwatas
bathala.origin: According to ancient myths, the Earth Mother Gaea gave birth to the three primary Diwatas: Bathala (Bathalang Maykapal), the supreme Sky Father and Diwatas' king; Aman Sinaya, goddess of the sea; and Amihan, god of the wind. Together, these three gods fashioned the first mortals from a bamboo shoot and instilled them with a soul ("kaluluwa"). Later, Bathala fell in love with a mortal woman while visiting Earth and sired three additional Diwatas: Apo Laki, god of war and the sun; the beautiful Mayari, goddess of the moon; and Tala, goddess of the stars. Subsequent generations of Diwatas soon followed, and they devoted much of their time and energies to serving as guardians of nature. Worship of the Diwatas spread throughout the Philippine archipelago. But following Spanish missionaries' arrival in the 16th century AD, Christianity began to replace the Diwatas' worship, and Bathala reluctantly decided that the time had come for his people to break most of their ties with Earth. Bathala retreated to the extradimensional realm of Kaluwalhatian, the location of the sacred "Abo Fire" that serves as the symbol of his power, where he has since defended his realm from his younger brother Aswang, the god of evil and ruler of the nether realm of Impiyerno, the lowest level of the Kasanaan underworld. Nevertheless, Bathala still retains a deep affection for and interest in the people of Earth.

batragon.origin: Batragon was once a normal bat and a normal Komodo dragon of which their genes were combined and then transformed into a gigantic monster by Doctor Demonicus' Lifestone. He sent Batragon to destroy an oil tanker, so he could steal the oil and use it to power his own equipment. Batragon's rampage earned the attention of another giant creature, Godzilla. The two monsters fought with one another in a battle that eventually drew them back to Doctor Demonicus' volcano lair on one of the Aleutian Islands in Alaska. In the end, Godzilla proved victorious and Batragon was killed.

battle lon.origin: Battle-Lon was the father of Battlejack, one of the champions summoned to Impericon in order to fight the Queen of Nevers, who was held captive as a leverage to make Battlejack fight the Queen, and remained imprisoned even after his son had died in battle. When Dawn Greenwood was teleported to Impericon as the leverage to make the Silver Surfer fight the Queen, she made a plan of escape with which the prisoners broke free and started heading to the escape vehicles. After Battle-Lon and the other prisoners escaped Impericon while the Silver Surfer and Dawn confronted Zed in order to give the Queen of Nevers her heart back, they realized they could honor their loved ones by helping Dawn get the heart to the Queen. The prisoners fought the Gatekeepers and allowed Dawn to get the Queen's heart back to its rightful owner.

battlescar.name: Battlescar
battlescar.origin: Battlescar was ordered by the Leader to kill his ex-leader: the Foreigner. He joined with Warzone and Dead Aim, and they waited for the Foreigner near Dead-Aim's base. Battlescar first hit Foreigner, slashing his arm, but although Foreigner was without the powers given by the Satellite, Foreigner managed to kick Battlescar's face. Battlescar was enraged and attacked anew, but the Foreigner avoided him and his talons only scratched a wall. Battlescar took another uppercut to the ribs and then had to jump to avoid Dead Aim blind-shots. Soon after Battlescar was shocked to understand that the satellite was falling on their heads and he could only watch as Spider-Man saved the day. Battlescar was knocked out by the explosion. Later, he was arrested by the Police.

battleship burke.name: Battleship Burke
battleship burke.origin: "Battleship" Burke was a Petty Officer in the United States Navy during the Korean War. He frequently got into altercations with soldiers in the People's Liberation Army of China along with his best friend, Seaman 1st Class "Salty" Smith. Their earliest recorded appearance occurred in October of 1950, where the pair diverted an enemy seamine field that was along the course an infantry ship that was due through the area. On December 10, 1950 occurred during downtime while Battleship and Salty were among the soldiers in Admiral Doyle's navy amphibious fleet that were waiting in Hangnam Harbor to proceed on a mission to rescue 1st Division marines retreating from the Changjin Reservoir. Battleship and Salty went to shore where they clashed with Chinese forces under the command of Hangnam Hannah who had set up a massive artillery cannon on skis to allow it to freely move and attack their fleet. Battleship and Salty managed to steal the cannon and dump it in the ocean, allowing Naval forces to destroy Chinese forces in the area and rescue the troops. On December 15th of that year, the pair assisted Navy and GI forces landing on the heavily fortified Inchon Harbor. Later that month, Battleship and Smith were sent to capture an enemy ship and found themselves captured by the Chinese instead. However they broke out of their cell with the help of South Korean freedom fighter Hoon Sik-Soon, who later sacrificed his life to stop the Chinese from destroying the nearby American battleship. Given 12 hour leave in Seoul, Battleship and Salty were captured by Red Mary and taken aboard her flee of junk ships armed with guns. She tried to force the pair to pilot their fleet through Naval sea mines, instead Burke led them to the destroyer he was stationed on and the pair abandoned ship as Red Mary's fleet was blasted out of the water. Later, Battleship and Salty were captured by a Chinese sub while returning from shore leave in Seoul. They were then forced to load torpedoes to attack their own ships, but instead sabotaged the torpedoes to boomerang back at the sub and escape. Not long after, while on another shore leave, they were charged with returning a "secret package" back to their ship. En route, they were captured by the forces of T'ao Kuk and brought to his hidden base. Having stashed the "secret package", Battleship and Salty broke free and sabotaged Kuk's base and escaped with their package. Upon returning to their ship they were shocked to learn the "secret" they were protecting was nothing more than a box of ice cream, which had melted during their daring escape. In August of 1952, Battleship and Salty were on shore leave so that Burke could deliver a present to his brother Shannon from their mother. Shannon was a member of the US Army and upon learning that Shannon and his commanding officer were captured by the enemy. Burke and Smith used their know how to help Shannon's unit rescue the prisoners and destroy a communist dam. In June of the following year, Battleship and Salty were tricked into going to the mainland where reports of Navy men being captured by enemy soldiers were being reported. However they were betrayed by the woman who led them there and taken prisoners themselves. However the woman soon rescued the pair, revealing that she worked with the communists because they had her son prisoner. Learning that enemy soldiers were going to try and infiltrate their command ship by wearing their stolen uniforms, Battleship and Salty rushed to the nearby peer just in time to see the ship sink as Salty had the forethought to remove the bailing plug from the ship before they were captured. Battleship and Salty were later sent to pick up the admiral's daughter from the Seoul airport. However the trio were captured by enemy troops and Salty was released to ransom off Battleship and the admiral's daughter in the hopes of leading the battleship into a trap. However Burke and the admiral's daughter managed to break free and signal the ship warning it of the trap. Later the pair were ordered to recover a sunken enemy ship which contained information on the enemy that could turn the tide of the war. The duo fought sharks, an octopus and enemy skin-divers in order to recover the plans, a major victory for the United Nations during the Korean War. Later the pair struck another major blow to the Chinese army when they posed as communist soldiers and single handedly destroyed the enemy base in Chunchow. Shortly thereafter the pair found themselves diving into the ocean once more, this time under orders to recover an enemy plane that they shot down. While on this operation Burke and Salty managed to incapacitate a mini-sub. Later while on three day shore leave, Burke and Salty accepted a challenge from two US Army soldiers to fight with them on the front line, and assisted in destroying an enemy ammo dump in a flooded rice paddy. The pair later prevented an attempt by captured communist soldiers from taking over their ship.

Later, Battleship and Salty were captured by a Chinese sub while returning from shore leave in Seoul. They were then forced to load torpedoes to attack their own ships, but instead sabotaged the torpedoes to boomerang back at the sub and escape. Not long after, while on another shore leave, they were charged with returning a "secret package" back to their ship. En route, they were captured by the forces of T'ao Kuk and brought to his hidden base. Having stashed the "secret package", Battleship and Salty broke free and sabotaged Kuk's base and escaped with their package. Upon returning to their ship they were shocked to learn the "secret" they were protecting was nothing more than a box of ice cream, which had melted during their daring escape. In August of 1952, Battleship and Salty were on shore leave so that Burke could deliver a present to his brother Shannon from their mother. Shannon was a member of the US Army and upon learning that Shannon and his commanding officer were captured by the enemy. Burke and Smith used their know how to help Shannon's unit rescue the prisoners and destroy a communist dam. In June of the following year, Battleship and Salty were tricked into going to the mainland where reports of Navy men being captured by enemy soldiers were being reported. However they were betrayed by the woman who led them there and taken prisoners themselves. However the woman soon rescued the pair, revealing that she worked with the communists because they had her son prisoner. Learning that enemy soldiers were going to try and infiltrate their command ship by wearing their stolen uniforms, Battleship and Salty rushed to the nearby peer just in time to see the ship sink as Salty had the forethought to remove the bailing plug from the ship before they were captured. Battleship and Salty were later sent to pick up the admiral's daughter from the Seoul airport. However the trio were captured by enemy troops and Salty was released to ransom off Battleship and the admiral's daughter in the hopes of leading the battleship into a trap. However Burke and the admiral's daughter managed to break free and signal the ship warning it of the trap. Later the pair were ordered to recover a sunken enemy ship which contained information on the enemy that could turn the tide of the war. The duo fought sharks, an octopus and enemy skin-divers in order to recover the plans, a major victory for the United Nations during the Korean War. Later the pair struck another major blow to the Chinese army when they posed as communist soldiers and single handedly destroyed the enemy base in Chunchow. Shortly thereafter the pair found themselves diving into the ocean once more, this time under orders to recover an enemy plane that they shot down. While on this operation Burke and Salty managed to incapacitate a mini-sub. Later while on three day shore leave, Burke and Salty accepted a challenge from two US Army soldiers to fight with them on the front line, and assisted in destroying an enemy ammo dump in a flooded rice paddy. The pair later prevented an attempt by captured communist soldiers from taking over their ship.

baxter anderson.name: Baxter Anderson
baxter anderson.origin: Baxter Anderson was a criminal involved in insider trading and real estate fraud, as well as a sexist grubby man who made lewd comments to any beautiful woman in hearrange no matter his relationship. Anderson hired thief Black Cat to obtain information with which he could blackmail the owners of New York City properties he wanted to buy, below market value, for redevelopment. He also hired supervillain Hydroman to cause "accidental" wreckages on those who were unwilling to sell, frequently owners of small family businesses in old buildings. The Cat also stole compromising information from Anderson himself, because she did not trust him, because she disliked his male chauvinism, and because he saw him harassing the owners of the Salvatore restaurant when they refused to sell and she suspected Anderson had something to do with the tidal wave that had wrecked the locale. The Black Cat entered Anderson's office to steal specific details, but she was followed by her former lover Spider-Man, whom she tried to convince about her reasons; and then both were attacked by Hydroman. Hydroman was defeated by the Black Cat and Spider-Man's teamwork; but the Cat escaped supposedly with relevant information (thou nothing was believed to be stolen). A few weeks later, Anderson was arrested for real estate fraud and insider trading, his fall being headlines in the Daily Bugle; and the Cat made an anonymous donation to the Salvatore restaurant so as to undo part of the damage Anderson had done.

baxu.name: Baxu
baxu.origin: Baxu was a general of Netherworld, a descendant realm of the continent of Atlantis and longtime advisor to its Queen Kala, with whom he was secretly in love. When Kala kidnapped weapons inventor Tony Stark to develop a device to transport her invasion armies to the surface world, he warned his queen about Iron Man's strength and urged her to delay her invasion plans. After Iron Man had thwarted her plans by showing her that she could not survive on the Earth's surface, she married Baxu at Iron Man's suggestion in order to become king. Their marriage was short lived as Kala has later stated that Baxu had died. His cause of death is unexplained.

bayan.name: Bayan
bayan.origin: Bayan was the last of the Sorcerer Kings who ruled over the land of Kaichek in another dimension, however the ambitious wizard Vung wished to defeat them all so he could have ruled over Kaichek himself. In order to do so, he made a deal with the N'Garai Demons, ancient enemies of the Sorcerers and convinced the whole population of Kaichek they were living in slavery and with the help of the former warrior Kan from Earth they were able to kill all the Sorcerers (or better, that was what they thought), but the N'Garai bonded with princess Shiamlar of the new kingdom, turning her into the Shadowqueen. Centuries later, the last of the King Sorcerers, Silver Fox started assembling an army against the new ruler, causing a Civil War in Kaicheck. When Shadowqueen decided to face the Sorcerer Supreme of Earth Doctor Strange, she sent her emissaries in Strange's dimension to kidnapp Wong and Clea. Once brought to the Shadowqueen's realm, the two hostages were going to be carried to Shialmar's palace, but Silver Fox (who's disguised as a simple soldier known as Bayan) attacked the small group of enemies, but was unable to save Wong. Weeks later, Strange himself came along in that dimension looking for his friends, and Bayan challenged him in showing him he was a real good wizard by magically creating the Vishanti's symbol; once doing that, Clea summarized the story she learnt to Stephen, before being interrupted by Bayan who had found out where's Wong. After the rescue of Wong (during that Bayan was forced to admit he was Silver Fox), Shadowqueen decided to intervene directly in the war by teleporting through shadows until Bayan's camp alongside her forces, who were able to turn every opponent into one of them. While Strange faced the Shadowqueen herself, Bayan did his best to protect Clea and Wong with his elemental powers; eventually, Shialmar was killed and so Bayan could rebuild his kingdom.

bayside butcher.name: Bayside Butcher
bayside butcher.origin: The Bayside Butcher was a serial killer, spending time in a psychiatric facility before being released. Once outside he began killing women and collecting their body parts for use in creating the perfect wax figure of Joan of Arc. He would visit the church of St. Luke and confess his murders to the priest. After killing six women, he was brought to the attention of the Punisher, who eventually tracked the Butcher to his wax sculpture. The Punisher tried to get the jump on the Butcher but the Butcher struck him down and escaped. The Punisher pursued him and a firefight ensued and the Butcher caught a bullet in the arm. He asked the Punisher to call an ambulance but the Punisher killed him.

beak nazi.name: Beak (Nazi)
beak nazi.origin: The Beak was a Nazi spy that was active during World War II. By January of 1943 the Beak had set up an operation in which he replaced supply trains carrying weapons and supplies to be shipped to the Russian war front with junk in order to sour relationships between the United States and Russia. To this end, he and his men had built a trap on along the rail line in which a tunnel was lined with gas vents that flooded the train with knock out gas that caused temporary amnesia. The Beak and his men then moved the train onto a separate track to a hidden warehouse where they opened all the crates and replaced the weapons with junk, then sent the train back on its way. The crew would come to with no memory of what happened leaving the authorities to wonder how the switch had occurred. The strange happenings led the military to call the Human Torch and Toro to assist in learning the truth. Aboard the next train shipment, they managed to get out of the tunnel before they were affected by the gas thanks to their quick thinking and flame powers. When they confronted the Beak and his men, their flames were doused with a fire retarding gas and knocked out. They were then tied up and taken to the Beak's hideout where the villain gloated about his victory over them and explained his operations. Unfortunately for the Beak, when the Torch and Toro broke free from their bonds, his gas gun jammed and he and his minions were easily captured and turned over to the FBI. His subsequent fate is unrecorded.

beak robber.name: Beak (Robber)
beak robber.origin: The criminal known as the Beak was a gang leader and bank robber who was active during the 1940s. In 1945 he and his gang decided to change tactics when they learned of oriental jewelry being put on display at the Woolsey Museum. To this end, they murdered the night watchman in order to steal his uniform. While attempting to dump his body they spotted Private Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes who were returning to base after leave. Pretending to have car trouble, the gang members told them to leave them alone. Suspicious, the two men changed into Captain America and Bucky and spotted the Beak and his men dumping the body and stealing its clothing. Cap and Bucky were unsuccessful at stopping the gang from getting away with all the dead watchman's clothing, except for his shoes. That night, the Beak had one of his men dress up in the watchman's uniform to report for the watchman's shift. There, he knocked out the daytime watchman and shut off the museum's alarm system. Before the Beak and his men could steal the jewels, Captain America and Bucky arrived and easily defeated the gang and turned them over to the authorities. The Beak's subsequent fate is unknown.

bear romanian.name: Bear (Romanian)
bear romanian.origin: A Romanian smuggler and crimelord with links to German gangsters so as to ensure flow of contraband from the Eastern bloc. After the revolution of Romania, he lost power and the Germans did not respect him as much. The Bear attended a meeting in Rottweil, trying to make a pan-European criminal alliance; but was distraught to hear that the Americans were involved and murdered the other crimelords; he then impersonated them in communications so as to bait the American gangster to a trap, but one of the involved people, Georges Batroc discovered about it. Punisher and his ally Morgan Sinclair arrived to Rottweil, on assassin Snakebite's trail. Believing them to be the American contacts, the Bear first played with them, then sent the Punisher in a supposed "hunt" with him as the prey and the Bear's men tracking him; he kept Sinclair tied. However, the Bear was misguided and was then found and shot by the real American gangster, Snakebite. Mentioning he was working for Kingpin, Snakebite left a bomb to get rid of "loose ends", even recognizing Sinclair there, and left. The Bear survived due to kevlar under his clothes and tried to use a secret escapeway, but the Punisher arrived, surprisingly alive. They fought, with Sinclair telling the Punisher about the bomb, and the Punisher finally killed the Bear using a hunting trap.

beast dog.name: Beast (Dog)
beast dog.origin: The dog that would be known as "The Beast" was born from the Inhumans' experimentation on canines, her mother had been brought to Attilan as a puppy and experimented on by the Surgeon Supreme. She was impregnated by her own cloned genetic material and gestated 5 puppies with the purpose of performing terrigenesis in the womb. Lockjaw was successfully mutated, while his siblings were not, and before the Surgeon could remove them from the womb for further experimentation he teleported his siblings to four different locations. The Beast was teleported to the Savage Land where she was found and adopted by a pack of Dire Wolves, eventually becoming their pack leader.

beast of cactus canyon.name: Beast of Cactus Canyon
beast of cactus canyon.origin: The Beast of Cactus Canyon's past and origins are a mystery, but like many creatures that exist on Earth-616, it was highly regarded as a myth. However, the legend of the Beast of Cactus Canyon attracted the interest of Hollywood, and in the summer of 1942, Marvel Films came to Cactus Canyon to shoot a movie based on the creature. The film continued production despite the fact that the locals warned that the film was a mockery of the beast, and for it the creature would kill them all. Myron, the crew's cameraman, discovered that the location they were shooting in was rich with uranium. Unaware that the property was owned by the government and he was unable to claim the rights to the find, he sought to frighten the crew away by posing as the monster. His initial attack attracted the attention of the other-dimensional hero known as the Vision, who prevented Myron from kidnapping the lead actress. Myron soon learned a fatal lesson in pretending to a monster when the real Beast of Cactus Canyon attacked and killed him. The Vision clashed with the creature but found it's strength impressive. Knocked into a tree, the beast lunge forward, ready to kill. But Vision pulled the sapling out and use it to impale the beast, thus ending its threat for good.

beast of frankenstein.name: Beast of Frankenstein
beast of frankenstein.origin: The Beast of Frankenstein was the creation of Nazi sympathizer Anna Frankenstein and her lover Von Rottz in the summer of 1944. They had hoped to use the works of Victor Frankenstein to create a monster for the Nazis much like her relative Basil before her. Succeeding in creating their monster, Anna then wrote to Captain America and Bucky to Castle Frankenstein in order to lure them into a trap. Invited to stay the night, Cap and Bucky were attacked by the creature, but managed to fight it off. Searching for it with Von Ratter, they were attacked again, this time the creature grabbed Bucky. Taking the young sidekick to the parapet of the castle, the monster tossed Bucky but he was saved by Captain America. Before Von Rottz could betray them, the creature attacked him and strangled him to death before grabbing Anna and fleeing into the woods. Captain America followed after the monster and freed Anna, then lured the monster into a quicksand pit where it drowned. After Cap confronted Anna with her Nazi background, Anna committed suicide in the same quicksand pit. Her father then set fire to her lab, destroying it. However others have since utilized Victor's techniques to create other monsters.

beast god.name: Beast-God
beast god.origin: The Beast-God was one of the Old Ones, who dwelt on Earth ages before the coming of mankind. Crawling in Vanaria, in the Northern Islands, during the centuries between the Final Cataclysm and the beginning of recorded history, he kept receiving human sacrifices. thumb|left|260px|Fighting with Beowulf (Vandal) (Earth-616)|Beowulf When Beowulf and his Vandals came to Vanaria to conquer it, one of their scouts, Ulwin, encountered the Beast-God and became mad, attacking his comrades before Beowulf slew him. Beowulf freed a maiden serving as sacrifice to the Beast-God, and killed the beast. Beowulf took control of Vanaria after slaying its king. The Ghost-Beast, the ghostly apparition of the Beast-God, coming back-and-forth from the Land of Shadows, eventually drove all Vandals to madness and death, leaving only a few of his men to hold the country. As the last of them died, the people of Vanaria captured Beowulf, intending to use him as a sacrifice to pacify the Ghost-Beast. Princess Ulana secretly poisoned Beowulf, for him to become a ghost and fight the Ghost-Beast again, finally destroying it. Beowulf realized his death only after having killed the monster.

The Ghost-Beast, the ghostly apparition of the Beast-God, coming back-and-forth from the Land of Shadows, eventually drove all Vandals to madness and death, leaving only a few of his men to hold the country. As the last of them died, the people of Vanaria captured Beowulf, intending to use him as a sacrifice to pacify the Ghost-Beast. Princess Ulana secretly poisoned Beowulf, for him to become a ghost and fight the Ghost-Beast again, finally destroying it. Beowulf realized his death only after having killed the monster.
powers: His stare caused madness among the mortals. Killed in the physical plane, he kept existing in ghost form until he was killed again.
fields.notes: As one of the Old Ones, still worshiped during the days between the "Final Cataclysm" (presumably the the Great Cataclysm, but the story could also be set after the Post-Hyborian Cataclysm), the Beast-God is reminiscent of similar bizarre and horrific deities created by Robert E. Howard and H.P. Lovecraft.

beasty brute.name: Beasty-Brute
beasty brute.origin: Beasty-Brute, along with his allies Sanzu and Soulscream, attempted to usurp Tyger Tiger, but she requested the intervention of her friends Patch and Cat who rushed to her aid. Initially Sanzu, with her powers, took away Kate Pryde's ability to become intangible and Logan's healing power, but despite the lack of their powers the three criminals did not calculate the resolve of the two heroes. Kate was able to hit Sanzu and throw her at Beasty-Brute who, due to her energy absorption powers, upon contact with Brute, knocked him out while she was overloaded and, unable to control the absorption of three people at the same time, Sanzu lost control of her power negation and Logan and Kate regained their ability and easily defeated the three criminals.

beatrice banner.name: Beatrice Banner
beatrice banner.origin: Beatrice Banner-Sterns was the wife of Reverend Robert Sterns, who was a cold and distant husband. Seeking companionship, Beatrice had an affair with Robert's brother, Samuel, who was studying then-still unnamed Gamma Radiation at the turn of the 20th century. Having discovered the adultery, Robert murdered his brother and disavowed his wife for infidelity, kicking her out of his house. Beatrice pleaded to him, being pregnant with a child, but Robert believed the child to be in fact his brother's and left her out in the winter cold despite her tears and curses.

beatrice bartholomew.name: Beatrice Bartholomew
beatrice bartholomew.origin: "Buddy" Bartholomew was a high school student and super hero. Her mother died when she was a child, and she always felt like an outsider until she saw the X-Men on television, which inspired to be like Cyclops. As a teenager, Bartholomew was the de-facto leader of the Children of the Atom, a group of young vigilantes modeled after members of the X-Men, and she took after her personal idol, becoming Cyclops-Lass. On their first mission, the team fought the Hell's Belles (a group of criminal depowered mutants) during a robbery. After the battle she and her team were questioned by the X-Men about why they had not come to Krakoa. After explaining that they could not come to Krakoa yet, Daycrawler teleported the team away to evade the approaching police susceptible to enforce the current ban on teen vigilantes. That very night, the team went to a gateway to Krakoa but were unable to pass through.

beatrice bass.name: Beatrice Bass
beatrice bass.origin: Beatrice was the daughter of Sadie Bass. When she went to visit her mother, at the sight of Gargoyle, who had been invited by Sadie for tea, he yelled at his mother to get away that he was a monster, but Sadie calmed her down by introducing Isaac to her and telling her that he was a friend of hers. Beatrice scolded her mother for letting a stranger into her house and told her they were late for their appointment with Dr. Bernbaum but Sadie told her she wasn't going to any doctor. The quarrel between the two women was stopped by Gargoyle who took them both on a flight around the city, pointing out how it teemed with life and how many aspects it was formed. Upon returning home, Sadie said goodbye saying that she was tired and that she needed to sleep and then die in her bed with her daughter and Gargoyle beside her.

beatrice de la salle.name: Beatrice de la Salle
beatrice de la salle.origin: Beatrice de la Salle is the headmistress of the Hull House orphanage. At one point she was a co-worker or employer of Eugene Judd, who spend some time working at the orphanage. The orphanage become secretly associated with the Super Hero Youth Acceleration Program of Department H. Beatrice would raise orphans with super-powers and notify the Department when they were ripe for recruitment. At least four known members of Alpha Flight were originally children from Hull House: Flex, Ghost Girl, Murmur, and Radius. They were presumably raised by Beatrice.

beatrix keener.name: Beatrix Keener
beatrix keener.origin: ===Serpent War=== Under an alliance with the Viper, Coachwhip invaded the Serpent Society with several colleagues in a plot to overthrow its leader Sidewinder and have Viper assume leadership. However, interference from Captain America foiled Viper's plans, and she abandoned Coachwhip and her other agents. Coachwhip then joined the Society under King Cobra's leadership. King Cobra later assigned Coachwhip to an initiation test alongside Puff Adder and Rock Python, which put her in direct conflict with Falcon. Although the trio suffered defeat, they were allowed to stay with the Serpent Society. During a mission that set the Serpent Society against the X-Men, Coachwhip battled Rogue. ===Acts of Vengeance=== Coachwhip briefly took time out of the Serpent Society to join villains Killer Shrike and the Ringer - whom the other two jokingly nicknamed "Ringo" - as they battled Moon Knight during the events of Acts of Vengeance. Moon Knight defeated Coachwhip and the Ringer, but the Shrike escaped. ===The Trial=== During Diamondback's trial, Coachwhip served as the prosecutor. She was able to convince the other members that she was guilty of treason and deserving of the death penalty. She had also become romantically involved with King Cobra. When Captain America came to Diamondback's rescue, Coachwhip fought against Diamondback and Black Mamba, two women Coachwhip had developed a strong disliking for. Despite ensnaring both women with her whips, Coachwhip was defeated, when Diamondback used her skill with thrown objects to throw a hypodermic needle at Coachwhip's head, knocking her out cold. Coachwhip later resurfaced with the Serpent Society as Jack Flag infiltrated their ranks. She briefly fought Jack's partner Free Spirit, though Free Spirit defeated Coachwhip and disguised herself in Coachwhip's costume. Coachwhip later regained consciousness and joined in the battle against the heroes. After another defeat, Coachwhip was taken into custody by Force Works. After some time apart, the Serpent Society reunited with Coachwhip among their numbers. They briefly fought Captain America and a Life Model Decoy of Diamondback. Coachwhip was next seen at the Bar with No Name, a bar for costumed super villains. ===Masters of Evil=== Coachwhip and China Force's Ox were among the vast number of super villains who traveled to Bagalia as part of the open invitation to join the Masters of Evil. ===Serpent Solutions=== After the original Viper took over the Serpent Society and rebranded it as Serpent Solutions, Coachwhip returned to the organization. She later joined Baron Helmut Zemo's Army of Evil during Secret Empire. Alongside other Serpent Society members, Coachwhip was hired by Constrictor to help steal Iron Fist's Book of the Iron Fist. The Serpent Society then clashed with Iron Fist, Sabretooth, Choshin, and Choshin's henchmen. After the battle was finished, only Coachwhip and Iron Fist remained conscious. Coachwhip revealed that she and the other serpents had no idea that the Constrictor they were allied with was actually the son of the original, Frank Payne, and not Payne himself. ===Hunted=== Coachwhip was among several animal-themed super villains captured by Taskmaster and Black Ant to serve as hunting targets in Central Park for Kraven the Hunter, Arcade, and a host of wealthy participants controlling robotic drones. Coachwhip was presumably apprehended alongside the rest of the Serpent Society when the force field keeping the villains inside Central Park went down. Coachwhip and other members of the Serpent Society were next seen at an auction held by Lady Iron Fan of Iron Eighty-Eight. ===Devil's Reign=== Along with Puff Adder, Coachwhip was hired by Kingpin to join his Thunderbolts and sent to take down Spider-Woman. The pair kidnapped Spider-Woman's close friend Lindsay McCabe to lure Spider-Woman into a trap, but found Spider-Woman too powerful for them to battle alone. Coachwhip and Puff Adder fled, stating that Kingpin could send "the other crew". ===Corrupted by Mephisto=== Coachwhip was among the members of the Serpent Society who were, under unknown circumstances, corrupted by the demon Mephisto. After going on a bloodthirsty rampage throughout the Serpent Solutions headquarters, Coachwhip and her teammates were defeated by Nighthawk. The Serpent Society later escaped custody and resumed their murderous activity on the Brooklyn Bridge.

bebop.name: Bebop
bebop.origin: Bebop was a S.H.I.E.L.D.'s LMD in the form of a bulldog. The Leader was able to control it remotely and download all the files from the SHIELD central computer but instead of giving it a simple "download" command, he wanted to make a joke and used the command "fetch," given the LMD's canine appearance. Because his brainwaves were based on those of an actual dog, this triggered Bebop to run away. Before the Leader could take it and steal the downloaded files, Spider-Man, She-Hulk, and Tigra began chasing it, and eventually, with the help of the Bebop, defeated and captured the Leader, and the downloaded files inside Bebop were safely returned to SHIELD.

beck assassin.name: Beck (Assassin)
beck assassin.origin: Beck was an assassin hired by the terrorist organization D.A.N.T.E. to kill the Japanese businessman Nishimura. Beck wasn't interested in getting paid, but instead, he wanted power to become a better assassin. Using stolen technology, D.A.N.T.E. turned Beck into a cyborg. After the plot to kill Nishimura failed due to interference from Captain America and Iron Man, the two heroes later devastated D.A.N.T.E. by destroying its headquarters and robotic soldiers. Beck and D.A.N.T.E.'s leader Emil Stein later tried to kill Nishimura at his townhouse. Iron Man killed Stein while Cap killed Beck by causing him to fall onto a spiked ornament after removing his armor.

becka mcbride.name: Becka McBride
becka mcbride.origin: Becka McBride, was an attorney to the peoples movement, but what she was really fighting against was the law. The law that allowed the rich to do as they want and the poor to be victims. In these times money is power, and the poor are nothing. After winning a lawsuit in court against a big business, she became a target for major corporations, her and her business associates. One by one they were hunted and killed. When it was finally her time to die, she came quietly after a threat was made toward her family. For a time she was calm, till she found out it was the work of a low-level telepath. Realizing that, she attempted to escape and was shot in the back. She fell to the ground, still alive. As they surrounded her, Sister Lucia, a vampire appeared and easily killed all the men. As Becka laid there dying, Lucia told her she could live--for a price. Becka closed her eyes as she was bitten and she opened them now-- every time-- as Lachryma.

beckah parker.name: Beckah Parker
beckah parker.origin: Beckah Parker was a member of the reality TV mutant group X-Force. Beckah joined the team before the recruitment of Edie Sawyer, as she was present during Edie's first meeting with their team leader Zeitgeist. Beckah took part in a a stealth mission of her team in North Africa. Zeitgeist intended to instruct Beckah to be more careful when using her powers. Her tremors had backfired, and she nearly killed their own team. The Coach informed Zeitgeist that their investors wanted most of the team's members to be killed and replaced. Zeitgeist reviewed film footage of Beckah in action, with the intention of using her powers against their teammates. During an argument between the members of X-Force, the frustrated Beckah claimed that she hated all of of her teammates. Battering Ram tried to calm her down. La Nuit figured that Beckah's long-term anxiety problems were affecting her behavior again. He suggested that Beckah should first drink some coffee, then take her anti-anxiety medication and try performing her breathing exercises. He also offered to use his darkness-related powers to obscure the obvious blotches on her skin. Zeitgeist suggested that Beckah should not take part in the team's upcoming press conference, but Beckah feared that she would loose her fanbase. U-Go Girl told Beckah that her fanbase was limited to alcoholics. Beckah physically attacked Edie in reaction to the nasty comment, but Plazm used his powers to calm her down. Beckah took part in a rescue mission, intended to free the boy band Boys R Us from their kidnappers. The team was ambushed by a helicopter attack, and Beckah was slain before she could react to the threat. Spike Freeman spitefully destroyed an expensive crystal print of Beckah and her teammates. The Orphan found recordings which confirmed that Zeitgeist and the Coach had plotted Beckah's death before her final mission.

beelzeboul.name: Beelzeboul
beelzeboul.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Beelzeboul, also known as Beelzebub, was an angel of Heaven. During Lucifer's rebellion against God, he was one of Lucifer's lieutenants, and was cast down to Hell. thumb|left He became a Hell-Lord. In Hell Beelzeboul became known as the "Prince of the Pit", the "Father to Evil in this world as well as yours" and the "Great Adversary", and also made himself known as Satan. ===Identity confusion=== The identity of Beelzeboul was often attributed to other entities, or usurped by them: Some cultures believed the entity now known as the Bete Noir was a demonic being such as Beelzebub, Mephistopheles or Satan. His name was also usurped by Neyaphem (demonic-looking mutant) Azazel, and by Mephisto. As the allegedly sole dark master over the souls of men, the god-thing known as Malik Tous was also known under others identities, including Satan, Ahriman, and Beelzebub. and the Devil. ===Modern days=== According to Mephisto, Beelzebub often mocked him for not "getting" Hitler. Charlie Hagarth was able to collect information about an apocryphal book, the Book of Satan, from various sources: "an obscure mention of it in hieroglyphics... a word in sanskrit there... a hint of it in Icelandic bardic poetry". In that book was the Hymn to Beelzebub, a sentence meant to enslave the Devil to do the speaker's biding. In order to protect himself, Beelzebub infiltrated the expedition as "Jean", to move the Book each time Hagarth was closing in. Ultimately, as he tried to remove the book from the tomb of Assadmaian, in Iraq, Beelzebub was forced to reveal himself to Hagart and devoured him, before looking for a new place to hide the book of Satan. He was summoned by Talvuras to defeat his opponents Dragonus/Dragonis and Thald. He killed Thald but failed to hit Dragonus, who used his dragon blade to pierce Beelzebub's heart. Seemingly mortally wounded, Beelzebub receded into the fire. When summoning Mephisto, Doom invoked his name along with Satan's, Baphomet's and Thog's. At some point, he built an ice road through Hell, but the road started to melt fast.

fields.history: ===Origin and early years=== Beelzeboul, also known as Beelzebub, was an angel of Heaven. During Lucifer's rebellion against God, he was one of Lucifer's lieutenants, and was cast down to Hell. thumb|left He became a Hell-Lord. In Hell Beelzeboul became known as the "Prince of the Pit", the "Father to Evil in this world as well as yours" and the "Great Adversary", and also made himself known as Satan. ===Identity confusion=== The identity of Beelzeboul was often attributed to other entities, or usurped by them: Some cultures believed the entity now known as the Bete Noir was a demonic being such as Beelzebub, Mephistopheles or Satan. His name was also usurped by Neyaphem (demonic-looking mutant) Azazel, and by Mephisto. As the allegedly sole dark master over the souls of men, the god-thing known as Malik Tous was also known under others identities, including Satan, Ahriman, and Beelzebub. and the Devil. ===Modern days=== According to Mephisto, Beelzebub often mocked him for not "getting" Hitler. Charlie Hagarth was able to collect information about an apocryphal book, the Book of Satan, from various sources: "an obscure mention of it in hieroglyphics... a word in sanskrit there... a hint of it in Icelandic bardic poetry". In that book was the Hymn to Beelzebub, a sentence meant to enslave the Devil to do the speaker's biding. In order to protect himself, Beelzebub infiltrated the expedition as "Jean", to move the Book each time Hagarth was closing in. Ultimately, as he tried to remove the book from the tomb of Assadmaian, in Iraq, Beelzebub was forced to reveal himself to Hagart and devoured him, before looking for a new place to hide the book of Satan. He was summoned by Talvuras to defeat his opponents Dragonus/Dragonis and Thald. He killed Thald but failed to hit Dragonus, who used his dragon blade to pierce Beelzebub's heart. Seemingly mortally wounded, Beelzebub receded into the fire. When summoning Mephisto, Doom invoked his name along with Satan's, Baphomet's and Thog's. At some point, he built an ice road through Hell, but the road started to melt fast.
powers: Beelzebub seemingly had pyrokinetic abilities: His heat could melt the weapons of his enemies His touch consumed those affected.
fields.notes: thumb|"Beelzebub" Shortly after her resurrection, Tarot created a psionic construct of Beelzebub (also called Belial, Crooked Serpent, the Father of Lies, the Angel of the Bottomless Pit, the Enslaver of Men) to fight the New Mutants and recover Cypher.

beetroot.name: Beetroot
beetroot.origin: Beetroot was transformed by the reality-bending Jaspers Warp created by the mutant known as Mad Jim Jaspers, which engulfed the U.K. several years ago. Like other "Warpies", he was tracked down by government agency R.C.X. (Resources Control Executive), supposedly for their own safety, and put in a prison evacuated specially for the Warpies. In truth, R.C.X. head Nigel Orpington-Smythe intended for them to be trained to become a superhuman army. Fearing for the safety of their charges if the plans of their superior went ahead, several R.C.X. agents, led by Agents Michael, Gabriel, and Raphael spirited the children away from the agency. They took them to Braddock Manor to enlist the aid of Captain Britain (Brian Braddock), figuring that he could lend them much needed protection, both physical and politically. However, the agents' decision to not fully inform the hero of their situation meant he was reluctant to help, and while they argued, the Cherubim were released from their van by Meggan. They fought Captain Britain and his allies, Betsy Braddock and Captain UK, but were swiftly overpowered. In the confusion afterwards the Cherubim went rogue and the other Warpies moved into Braddock Manor. thumb|left|165px He witnesses an intruder in the Manor but was too late to warn Michael about the bomb plot in the base, who exploded, seemingly killing him and wounding Beetroot. He was transferred to the Cloud Nine where he died. His death extended the trauma to Alistaire Stuart who assisted Beetroot's end.

behemoth kay twelve.name: Behemoth (Kay-Twelve)
behemoth kay twelve.origin: The Behemoth was a giant robot created by the Committee to fight the Werewolf. Baron Thunder instructed it to attack Jack Russell at his condo and to bring him to the Committee's headquarters. When the Behemoth had attacked, however, Jack had already transformed into the Werewolf and attacked the large construct. Though the Behemoth was much stronger than the beast, the Werewolf was able to use his claws to tear the large hands right off the robot. When the outcome of the battle looked uncertain, Baron Thunder summoned the Behemoth back to the Committee's headquarters for repairs.

bei.name: Bei
bei.origin: ===Origins=== Bei the Blood Moon was a mutant of Arakko with the power of the "Doom Note", allowing her to level mountains with her voice and to be understood by any living being. Wielding the blade Seducer, she became a huntress and warrior of great renown. ===X of Swords=== After Saturnyne arranged for a tournament between the islands of Krakoa and Arakko, Bei was one of the swordbearers chosen by prophecy to fight for Arakko. She was easily recruited by Summoner, requiring only the promise of battle to agree. thumb|leftBei took part in the tournament and in her first challenge faced off against Krakoan mutant Cypher, whose own powers over language rendered him incapable of understanding her (since she does not communicate via language). Instead of fighting as expected, she was to wed Cypher, earning each team a point for completing the ceremony. She took part in two more challenges, a dance contest and a duel against Cable, both of which she won for Arakko. At the end of the tournament, the scores between the two islands were even ahead of the final challenge; a duel between Apocalypse and his wife, Genesis possessed by the elder god Annihilation. Apocalypse gained the upper hand, causing Annihilation to seize control over its host and summon its demonic army. While her fellow swordbearers contemplated what to do, most deciding to hunt the Krakoans for sport, Bei decided to abandon their cause and save her husband. thumb|right|Unmasked She stole Doug away from his compatriots and tried to bring him to safety, but was convinced to take him back and stand with the Krakoan mutants against the hordes of Amenth. While the battle initially looked grim, the Krakoans managed to win through the intervention of the X-Men, Captain Britain Corps, and the Vescora. After the end of the tournament, Arakko was free from Amenth's rule and moved to Earth, yet Bei moved to Krakoa to live with her husband. ===Krakoa=== After a honeymoon, Bei moved into Doug's home on Krakoa and was introduced to his friends. When Merlin and King Arthur enacted a plot to seize control of Avalon and rid Otherworld of mutants once and for all, Bei fought alongside Excalibur to defend Otherworld for mutantkind. Later, she and Doug invited Shatterstar and Rictor over for dinner. Bei apprised them of events in Otherworld and, together with Doug, transcribed Apocalypse's magic tome left to Rictor. She then joined him and Shatterstar in the formation of the Knights of X to continue safeguarding Otherworld. After Doug was swallowed by Krakoa in its attempt to protect him, Bei frantically but unsuccessfully employed telepaths and scent trackers to find a way to him. Shortly afterwards, she participated in the offensive against Genesis on Arakko's new home planet in order to serve her people and distract her from her grief. ===Revelation=== After the war against Genesis, Bei remained on Arakko to assist with the recovery effort. She was eventually invited by Apocalypse to reunite with her husband, who had been freed by Krakoa during its destruction and the fall of the nation upon its soil. She proudly witnessed his transformation into "Revelation", becoming Apocalypse's successor to watch over mutantkind on Earth and ensure their survival.

fields.personality: Bei is famously taciturn and did not speak for the first few decades of her life. She has become more forthcoming with new friends and comrades since moving to Krakoa. Like most Arakki, she believes in the rigors of battle as being transformative and a source of self-discovery. Bei cherishes her marriage to Doug, and held a thinly-veiled attraction to him even during their first meeting as opponents. She is charmed by Doug's gentleness and interest in language, and immensely fears losing or hurting him.
weapons: Seducer: Bei the Blood Moon wields the blade named Seducer.
fields.notes: Bei, along with all the Swordbearers introduced during "X of Swords," was initially envisioned by Jonathan Hickman and designed by Pepe Larraz.
fields.trivia: In a continuity error, Doug and Bei managed to understand and converse with one another in .

bekkit.name: Bekkit
bekkit.origin: Bekkit was a member of a sect of Lemurian telepaths known as the Ancients. The Ancients were opposed to the mad Lemurian king Naga who, via the power of the Serpent Crown, had ruled Lemuria for over 500 years. After the murder of their brother Aurwel, Bekkit and Psycatos sneaked into Naga's castle, stole the Serpent Crown and smuggled it to Antarctica. There the Ancients found a dynamo left behind by the pre-Cataclysm Atlantis and founded a colony on the surface of Antarctica. Bekkit's wife Jhandark devised a potion that turned the Lemurians Caucasian and allowed them to live on the surface. Bekkit and his wife and children left the community to contact the human race. During his years away Bekkit founded a group of telepaths who in scholarly circles in the 19th century also became known as the ancients. An elderly Bekkit returned to the community his brother Psycatos ruled in Antarctica and learned that they had all been corrupted and turned into Serpent Men by the elder god Set. Bekkit cursed Psycatos for betraying everything they believed in before Psycatos killed him. Psycatos killed himself and used the dynamo to bury himself and the Serpent Crown for centuries.

fields.history: Bekkit was a member of a sect of Lemurian telepaths known as the Ancients. The Ancients were opposed to the mad Lemurian king Naga who, via the power of the Serpent Crown, had ruled Lemuria for over 500 years. After the murder of their brother Aurwel, Bekkit and Psycatos sneaked into Naga's castle, stole the Serpent Crown and smuggled it to Antarctica. There the Ancients found a dynamo left behind by the pre-Cataclysm Atlantis and founded a colony on the surface of Antarctica. Bekkit's wife Jhandark devised a potion that turned the Lemurians Caucasian and allowed them to live on the surface. Bekkit and his wife and children left the community to contact the human race. bekku bibari.name: Bekku Bibari
bekku bibari.origin: Bekku Bibari was Otoha Okutamiya's middle school teacher. She worriedly welcomed Otoha back to class after her discharge from the hospital. Ineffectually, she tried to cover the bullying graffiti on her table. She later witnessed Otoha, who was actually possessed by Doctor Octopus, attempting to attack several of her classmates. The real Otoha's spirit stopped this attack, and she ran away. The next day, Octavius explained the situation to her. In shock, she just accepted it as he dragged Deirogi Denko and Maruko Marika to the rooftop to "deepen their friendship." Despite her seeming passivity, she actually followed them and eavesdropped on their conversation. Later, she asked Otoha to look after them. The following day, she asked Otoha if she knew the reason for Touma Taka's absence. She also had her help clean one of Deirogi's graffiti. After Doctor Octopus quickly finished the task, she was once again left flabbergasted. She asked him not to hurt any of the students, which was enough to please his ego. When Deirogi appeared, Octopus attacked her, and Bekku tried to get them to make up. However, Deirogi just hit Otoha and ran away. Despite this, she expressed concern for Deirogi and lamented not being able to contact her parents. Later that day, Otoha asked her to accompany her to the police station to resolve Deirogi's situation. However, on their way, they happened to see Deirogi, who was being chased by Shou. Otoha immediately went after them to help, leaving her teacher behind. Bekku caught up to them after Doctor Octopus and Sakura Spider had webbed up Shou and his boss. She was the one to call the ambulance and the police. A couple of days later, she was attacked by Doctor Octopus' tentacles on high alert mode before he got dragged outside by Deirogi and Maruko.

bel cummings.name: Bel Cummings
bel cummings.origin: left|thumb|Bel Cummings before the accidentBel Cummings was an actor who performed in Hollywood during the 1930s and 1940s, working at Colossal Pictures Inc. One day a fire ripped through the studio that left Bel horribly scarred, ending his acting career. True or not, he personally blamed Colossal Pictures producer Jerry Small, as well as actor Sonja Blake and Lake Wood for the accident. As part of his plan, he developed the alter ego of Larry Shore, and became a successful Hollywood screenplay writer and purchased Tarrymore Castle on Mad Mountain. By 1946 he was Colossal Pictures hottest writer, none the wiser of his ruse. He then sold Jerry Small a script for a horror film called "The Death of Scarface". Jerry accepted the script, and agreed to cast Blake and Wood and shoot the film at Tarrymore Castle. thumb|right|108px|Bel Cummings after the accident. There, the filming attracted the attention of Captain America and Bucky who believed that Sonja Blake was really being attacked, but stood down when they realized it was a film shoot. However, this caused the heroes guards to be down when Bel killed Larry Wood and took his place under the Scarface mask and strangled Sonja Blake to death. By the time Cap and Bucky reacted to the murder, Cummings broke the studio lamps and escaped through a secret passage way. Changing into his Larry Shore identity he returned pretending to have just arrived on the set from L.A. He then began acting bravely, wandering off into the castle with his gun to try and distance himself from his alter ego. thumb|left|96px|Posing as Larry ShoreWhen Cap began suspecting that Shore was responsible for the murders, "Shore" then faked his own death. When Cap searched his body, he found an article about Bel Cummings and left Bucky in charge while he went back to the city and researched the star. When he learned the story behind Cummings accident, he returned to the shoot convinced that Cummings was responsible. Trying to use Jerry as bait, Cap and Bucky were captured and left to drown in a room filling with water. However, the two heroes freed themselves and pulled "Larry Shore" off of Jerry Short. Chased through the castle, "Shore" was knocked off a balcony by Cap and suffered a fatal fall. Unmasked, Cummings revealed his whole plot before dying.

bel hissar.name: Bel-Hissar
bel hissar.origin: Bel-Hissar was the king of Acheron in an unspecified era. Bel-Hissar was given by Naka, a diver for pearls, a great ruby grasped from the hand of a giant mummified king sitting on a jade throne in an undersea city. Despite his lords begging him to throw the gem back into the water, considering the gem belonged to the sea-gods, the king kept it. Soon afterwards, he was slain in his very palace by an unnamed thief, who stole the gem, who became known from that day as the Blood of Bel-Hissar.

bela graj.name: Bela Graj
bela graj.origin: Gregori was the son of the sorcerer Florian Graj. He was used by his father as a means of dissuasion to prevent some young men from deserting from the army. Bela together with his three brothers pretended to want to desert and together with the would-be deserter they crossed a threshold and beyond the threshold the would-be deserter lived his life in the body of Bela Horzy thus experiencing the shame of having to become a pariah among his peers ignored even by his closest friends.
