bennet du paris moira vii 1.name: Bennet du Paris (Moira-VII.1)
bennet du paris moira vii 1.origin: ===Sins of Sinister First Decade=== After being killed by Mister Sinister, Exodus was resurrected with his DNA tainted by Sinister, instilling loyalty to his cause and a personality shorn of ethics. Along with other sleeper Sinisters on the Council, he worked towards the goal of total Krakoan dominion over Earth. Within ten years, they had secured their grip on the planet, converting most of the population and the entirety of the council into Sinisters, and managed to undo Sinister's top-level control imprints, granting them a greater level of self-determination. They defied their "creator", choosing to pursue war against the interstellar empires rather than focus on Sinister's goal of becoming a Dominion. ===Sins of Sinister First Century=== thumb|left Within a hundred years, the council had established the Empire of the Red Diamond and all but destroyed all interstellar competition. Together with his messiah Hope Summers, Exodus led an attack on one of the last strongholds of the alien Compact, ending with its destruction. With their enemies destroyed, the council looked towards finding new worlds to conquer. To that end, they prepared an interstellar exploration vessel that would chart the cosmos in search of new worlds, and comissioned Sinister to create a new chimera perfectly engineered to captain the vessel; Rasputin IV. After letting it slip that he had now reached the ultimate peak of the chimera process, Xavier and his fellow council members decided that he had outlived his usefulness. Before they could get rid of him, he freed Rasputin from her control imprints and stole the vessel together with her, to leave in search of his Moira Engine. While attack a nest of Chitauri pirate worlds, Exodus lured Hope into leaping into the fray without him, leaving her bereft of his powers. He scornfully told her that he had grown sick of her petulant, childish personality and believing that she was of more use to his church as a dead messiah than a live one. Hope was then murdered by the Chitauri. Exodus then had her corpse retrieved and dissected into living reliquaries. ===Sins of Sinister First Milennium=== Nearly 900 years later, mutants were the undisputed rulers of the galaxy. With their enemies long since destroyed, they instead turned on each other, leading to the creation of at least a million Sinister-derived gene polities. The so-called "Gene-Reformation" led to the schism of Exodus' church into thousands of heretical subsects. Each of these maintained their own Prayerworlds, with giant clones of Exodus himself, powered by the worship of countless cloned minds. Each kept their Exodus clones pointing across the void at one another, some in states of war, others in temporary cease fires. While infiltrating one of the Prayerworlds, Mr. Sinister and Rasputin IV triggered a conflict between the sects of Prayerworld 534-2386 and Prayerworld 537-2389, leading to the scouring of an entire solar system and promising to cause a war that would spread and demand an unimaginable body count. Exodus, and all his clones, were destroyed when Sinister activated a kill-switch, killing every mutant in the galaxy.

bennett revere.name: Bennett Revere
bennett revere.origin: ===Youth=== thumb|left|156px|Bennett Revere in his youth Bennett Revere was an accomplished pilot and mechanic on Earth-5106 a world where rocket technologies and space travel saw great advancements in the 1950s. In the year 1960 Bennett turned 20 and had grown an aspiration to be a rocket test pilot. His aspirations grew to an obsession to the point where he would sneak past security at the local military base to peek over the wall and watch the technicians work on a new government funded rocket program. Mistaken as a spy, Bennett was arrested and although Mayor Kenneth Hale did not think Bennett to be a spy he still followed the rule of law and had Revere locked in the base stockade. As fate would have it, Bennet's arrest happened on the day of a crucial rocket test that would either call and end or guarantee continued government funding for continued rocket research. When base staff could not find anyone who could fit in the rocket without compromising the weight limits, Hale noted that young Bennett met the 130 pound weight limitation and decided to risk putting the young man on board the rocket. Bennett was finally living his dream, and while touring the solar system earned the nickname "Blast" due to his frequent use of the verb to describe their space travel. Upon their return to Earth, "Blast" Bennett was surprised to find that Hale had pulled some strings and had Washington consent to enlisting Revere so that he could assist on further rocket tests. By 1970, Blast Revere had become a brash and daring rocket pilot willing to push it to the limit in order to see the advancement of rocket technology, even at the risk of his own life. He soon became smitten by a young woman named Wanda Lane and one day won her sympathy and eventually love by feigning injury after purposely crashing a rocket ship. bennington brown.name: Bennington Brown
bennington brown.origin: Bennington Brown was a hypnotist who used his powers of hypnosis for crime. At one point he used it to steal an entire stagecoach which he rode to Eagle Bend, Texas. He confessed his crime to the sheriff, but the hypnotized victims refused to press charges. Brown then robbed the local bank by hypnotizing the staff into giving him the money, and slowed down the reactions of a man with a gun, outdrawing him in a gunfight. When the sheriff arrived, Brown once again avoided charges by hypnotizing the bank staff into saying the money belonged to him. The outlaw Kid Colt had broken out of jail in Eagle Bend and challenged Brown, who bested Colt in hand-to-hand combat using his hypnosis. When Colt realized what Brown's trick was, he challenged him to a gunfight, but didn't look Brown in the eye. He outdrew Brown, and shot his gun, causing an explosion that blinded Brown. Later, having regained his sight, Brown was summoned by Iron Mask to a meeting along with Dr. Danger and the Fat Man. Iron Mask proposed that they join their unusual powers to commit crimes while posing as a team of circus performers. They performed in Phoenix, Arizona, and Brown demonstrated his powers of hypnosis to crowds, causing one man under his influence to float in mid-air. When the Fat Man saw Kid Colt in the crowd, the four crooks knocked him out, and turned him over to the sheriff. This won them an invitation to the governor's party that evening. The Circus of Crime performed at the governor's party, then had Brown hypnotize the sheriff in order to disarm him, as he was the only armed man present. They began to rob the guests, but Kid Colt had escaped jail, and fought all four of them. Brown tried to use his hypnosis against Colt, but Colt grabbed a barrel and shoved it over his head, then tipped him over. The Circus of Crime were then all arrested.

benson wwii.name: Benson (WWII)
benson wwii.origin: In 1941, Benson would lead an expedition into Tibet to find beings that the natives called "Walking Mountains" who were supposedly immortal as well as invulnerable. Discovering the creature, Benson's associate Finley would learn that their one fatal weakness was loud noises and they would enslave the Oriental Giants and bring them back with them to the United States. Crooked business men, they would eventually land in trouble with the FBI who would being investigating them for income tax invasion. When Finley would begin to panic, Benson would have the giants slay him. Benson would then use the giants to slay those investigating his business dealings, almost slaying Betsy Ross until she was saved by Captain America and Bucky. Becoming greedy and seeking to obtain wealth and power, Benson would send the creatures to attack Camp Lehigh and commit robberies across the area amassing him a considerable fortune. Tracking Benson to his hide out, Captain America would be captured and told by Benson where he found the creatures and what their weaknesses are. When Bucky would smash into the hideout and free Cap, they would use the cannon that Benson had to keep the giants in line. The resulting blast would not only slay the giants, but Benson would die in when his hideout would collapse on him.

bentley newton.name: Bentley Newton
bentley newton.origin: Algernon Rottwell was a madman sent to Dunwich Sanatorium, where his insanity was diagnosed as incurable. He was locked in a special cell made specifically for him. He caused a riot and took control of the Sanitorium, allowing the patients to take the place of workers, killing the workers to harvest their brains, and keeping the former warden hostage. He was also hired by mobsters to create murderers in order to do their biding. thumb|left One day, when Logan was investigating the sanitorium, Dr. Rot captured him and turned him into one of his patients. Rot erased Logan's memories and tried to awake his bloodlust instinct. After a few weeks, when Logan began remembering, Rot had Logan strapped to an operation table in his laboratory and connected Logan's brain into his "God Brain Machine," a device that allowed him to manipulate, view and shut off people's thoughts, and found a code with trigger phrases that Weapon X had introduced into Logan's brain in order to control him. When a group of mobsters arrived at the facility, due to some of their members going missing, Dr. Rot unleashed the patients on them. During this time, Logan's teammates Nightcrawler and Psylocke arrived at the asylum to rescue him, and began defusing the Dr. Rot's machine. Logan was able to free himself and disembowel Rot. However, Rot managed bandage himself and get away, but not before assuring Logan that they would meet again. When Sabretooth threw a party for his birthday, Dr. Rot tried to join the celebration, but he wasn't invited and was forced to leave. Rot eventually began to use the trigger words he had implanted in Logan's brain to control him and use him to harvest more brains. Logan caught notice that he was being manipulated, and tried to find Rot, only to be ambushed by Rot's Flesh Puppets. Once Logan managed to find the Rottwell residence, he was ambushed and captured by Rot's "family" of fellow deranged psychopaths. After torturing Logan, Rot managed to break down his mental defenses and overrode his brain and personality with that of Tater Pud, one of his "family" members whom Logan had fatally injured. When the FBI arrived at the Rottwell residence to investigate, Rot had his family attack them. Logan was eventually able to take control back of his body and murdered Rot's family before killing Rot himself, and he burned the residence down afterwards. However, Rot's assistant, Nurse Fester, brought him back through a clone body. When Deadpool held an auction for a malfunctioning Rigellian Recorder, Rot and his family were among the villains who tried to get their hands on the robot, but Deadpool and his Mercs for Money sold the robot to the Ozarks Kingpin. Rot then tried to create an army of pig monsters, but he was eventually busted by B. Urich and J. Drew Private Investigators, thanks to Ulysses Cain who foresaw this.

fields.history: Algernon Rottwell was a madman sent to Dunwich Sanatorium, where his insanity was diagnosed as incurable. He was locked in a special cell made specifically for him. He caused a riot and took control of the Sanitorium, allowing the patients to take the place of workers, killing the workers to harvest their brains, and keeping the former warden hostage. He was also hired by mobsters to create murderers in order to do their biding. thumb|left One day, when Logan was investigating the sanitorium, Dr. Rot captured him and turned him into one of his patients. Rot erased Logan's memories and tried to awake his bloodlust instinct. After a few weeks, when Logan began remembering, Rot had Logan strapped to an operation table in his laboratory and connected Logan's brain into his "God Brain Machine," a device that allowed him to manipulate, view and shut off people's thoughts, and found a code with trigger phrases that Weapon X had introduced into Logan's brain in order to control him. When a group of mobsters arrived at the facility, due to some of their members going missing, Dr. Rot unleashed the patients on them. During this time, Logan's teammates Nightcrawler and Psylocke arrived at the asylum to rescue him, and began defusing the Dr. Rot's machine. Logan was able to free himself and disembowel Rot. However, Rot managed bandage himself and get away, but not before assuring Logan that they would meet again. When Sabretooth threw a party for his birthday, Dr. Rot tried to join the celebration, but he wasn't invited and was forced to leave. Rot eventually began to use the trigger words he had implanted in Logan's brain to control him and use him to harvest more brains. Logan caught notice that he was being manipulated, and tried to find Rot, only to be ambushed by Rot's Flesh Puppets. Once Logan managed to find the Rottwell residence, he was ambushed and captured by Rot's "family" of fellow deranged psychopaths. After torturing Logan, Rot managed to break down his mental defenses and overrode his brain and personality with that of Tater Pud, one of his "family" members whom Logan had fatally injured. Rottwell" is possibly a reference to either or both of two authors whose works may have inspired elements of the short story (which introduces the town of Dunwich, seemingly the reference to the Dunwich Sanatorium) and other Cthulhu Mythos-related works: Algernon Blackwood, another famous horror author included by Lovecraft as one of the "Modern Masters" in the section of that name in "Supernatural Horror in Literature". "The Wendigo" inspired both the works of Lovecraft and August Derleth. , which wrote "By the North Sea", a poem about the lost port of , Suffolk, England. That poem was in an anthology owned by Lovecraft.

beomund.name: Beomund
beomund.origin: Beomund was a Saxon follower of the old pagan faiths on Earth-555. At some point before the undead outbreak, Beomund was discovered hiding a runestone dedicated to Wotan within his fields. For this offense he was executed by Simon of Bowland, who beheaded him as part of Lord Gervase's campaign against pagan worship. When the Darkhold's influence spread across the land, Beomund rose from the dead alongside numerous other corpses. His animated remains were among those that attacked Simon and the Christian soldiers responsible for his death.

bercilak de hautdesert.name: Bercilak de Hautdesert
bercilak de hautdesert.species: Human empowered by merging with the Green Man
bercilak de hautdesert.origin: The Green Knight is an entity resulting from the merger between the Green Man, the aspect of the primordial Earth Mother Gaea representing life and rebirth, and the mortal nobleman Bercilak de Hautdesert. The Green Knight is known as the Lord of the Wild, whose pulsing lifeblood feeds the very heart of nature, and the personification of the lifeforce of the Earth realm. It is believed that if the Green Knight dies, the world dies with him. Since the dawn of time, the Green Man has been engaged in an eternal struggle with his antithesis, the Red Lord, Gaea’s dark aspect, which represents decay and entropy. Their age-old rivalry is never intended to have a victor or loser, as it preserves the balance of nature. Throughout the ages, the Green Man and Red Lord have used mortals and gods alike as their proxies to oppose each other. left|thumb|The Green Knight gathers his Pendragons In 5th century Britain, with the help of Gaea's high priestess Morgan Le Fay, the Green Man merged with mortal nobleman Bercilak de Hautdesert, becoming the Green Knight so that mortals of that time could better comprehend him. He then ventured to King Arthur's court in Camelot and formed a sacred bond with the knight Gawain, resulting in a pact between mankind and nature that neither should take more than he can give back or destroy more than he can replace. Retreating to his Green Chapel within Avalon, the Green Knight watched over the Pendragon spirits, ageless auras that carry with them skills and traits from previous hosts, granting the current hosts augmented abilities, powers and senses to be used in the Green's defense. In the past, these champions included King Arthur Pendragon and the Knights of the Round Table. In modern times, the Green Knight began to grow weak due to mankind's environmental abuses and desperately lashed out by killing several mortals who were ravaging the planet and its biosphere as a result of the Red Lord's influence. He then empowered a new generation of the Knights of Pendragon to fight the Bane, the Red Lord’s destructive disciples. The new Pendragons included the superhero Albion, who became a Pendragon during the first World War, and, more recently, the Knights of Pendragon. Whether the Green Knight had any connection to the Pendragon spirit which was given to the Black Knight is unclear, though it seems likely. Although several Pendragons were killed in their efforts to stop the Red Lord from venturing to Earth from the netherworld realm of Annwn, the Green Knight resurrected them to prevent the Bane from invading Otherworld. The Red Lord's army ultimately retreated, and the Knights of Pendragon began using the Green Chapel as their base. left|thumb|180px|The Green Knight assuming a human form Most recently, during an extraterrestrial Skrull invasion of Otherworld, the Green Knight unusually offered minimal resistance and assumed the form of a human knight as opposed to his preferred wooden large form. He was temporarily incapacitated until Captain Britain defeated the Skrull invaders and was later restored by Pete Wisdom and MI13 after Wisdom unleashed dark magic. thumb|200px|The Green Knight and his harbingers The Green Chapel recently became the target of the Manchester Gods during their war against the Lords and old gods of Otherworld. The Manchester Gods hoped to weaken the old gods' hold over Otherworld by destroying their places of power; however, the Green Knight fiercely defended his Chapel. During the events of the Revolutionary War, the Green Knight was paralyzed by Mys-Tech, using their corrupting influence and the DNA of original Knights of the Round Table to create zombie versions with a Zombie King Arthur leading them. It was thanks to Pete Wisdom once again that the Green Knight was freed. As a result of Avalon being the Collective Unconscious of the British citizens, the Green Knight's appearance was transformed into an enormous likeness of British track athlete , capable of reviving its champion Sir Gawain.

bernard barton.name: Bernard Barton
bernard barton.origin: thumb|220px|left|Charles in his childhood (left; Charles & right; his younger brother, Clint) ===Early Life=== Charles Bernard Barton (nicknamed Barney) was born on August 4th to Harold and Edith Barton. He grew up working in his father's butcher shop in Waverly, Iowa with his younger brother Clint. Their father was abusive, especially when he drank and continually beat the young boys. Barney taught Clint how to fight and helped him to improve his aim. Harold's drinking eventually cost him his life along with his wife when both died in a car accident, leaving the two boys orphans. The boys were placed in numerous foster homes, and when Clint turned 13, the boys ran away from one of them. The boys eventually came across a carnival. The two boys took up odd jobs at the Carson Carnival of Traveling Wonder as roustabouts, and both became impressed with one of the star performers, Jacques DuQuesne also known as the Swordsman. The Swordsman asked the boys if they wished to help in his act and while Barney declined, Clint jumped at the chance. After many successful shows, the Swordsman asked fellow performer Trickshot to train Clint in archery. At this point Barney accused Clint of being used by the Swordsman. Sometime later Barney was interested in obtaining his G.E.D. after getting a decent score on his SATs. Clint was only obsessed with the show and improving his archery skills. When Barney tried to persuade Clint to take an interest in his education, he was angered, the brothers argued, and Barney reminded him that he had his own life to lead. Barney became jealous and bitter for being overlooked by his idol. Later, when Clint was severely injured at the hands of the Swordsman for discovering his embezzlement scheme, Barney condemned his brother for not remaining loyal to his mentor. Barney became fed up with life at the carnival and decided to get a fresh start by joining the Army. He asked Clint to join him and again he declined. Barney told him the offer was still there and waited with hope at the bus depot. Barney got on the bus, saddened by the absence of his brother. Clint eventually turned up only to see the bus leave without him. right|thumb|200px After a successful career in the army, Barney joined the FBI. His first assignment as an agent was to go undercover as a bodyguard for a criminal called Marko. Coincidentally his brother Clint and Trickshot attempted to rob Marko's mansion. During the robbery Barney was shot with an arrow by his brother and when Clint learned what he had done, he was devastated. Clint refused to leave his brother's side and turned against Trickshot. Trickshot was angered by the betrayal, wounding Clint with an arrow and leaving. His next undercover assignment was to pose as a racketeer. He was approached by Egghead, who asked Barton to help finance his space station. Barton declined and called Egghead a nutcase; Egghead retaliated by sending a robot to kill him. Barton survived and sought out his brother Hawkeye, who was a member of the Avengers, informing him of Egghead's plans and accompanying the team to the space station. When Egghead used a paralysis ray on the Avengers, Barton sacrificed his life to destroy the ray-projector. After the funeral, Clint received a letter from FBI agent Allan Scofield revealing Barney's double life. The letter also revealed that Barney was aware of Clint's double life. left|thumb|200px ===Blindspot=== It was later revealed that Barney's body was taken by Egghead, who discovered there were faint vital signs and placed him in one of his accelerated healing chambers. When Egghead was eventually killed by Hawkeye in a final battle with the Avengers, the chamber was left lost and forgotten. Baron Zemo discovered the chamber, and holding a personal grudge against Hawkeye, he manipulated Barney to turn brother against brother. Baron Zemo then enlisted Hawkeye's own mentor Trickshot, who was once again suffering from cancer. Zemo recruited him to train Barney to be as proficient with a bow and arrow as his brother. When the training was complete, Trickshot was badly beaten and his cancer continued to spread. Barney then took the dying Trickshot to Avengers Tower as a message to Hawkeye. Sometime later while investigating his former mentor's death, Hawkeye was attacked by his brother, declaring himself the new Trickshot. Barney defeated his brother and took him to Baron Zemo. Zemo had the brothers duel to the death, but Hawkeye managed to best Trickshot in battle. Before teleporting away, Zemo transferred Trickshot's funds over to the winner, Hawkeye, then taunts the hero for turning his brother against him. Later in custody, Trickshot agreed to provide a bone marrow sample for transplant to save his brother's sight, but only so he could fight his brother again in the future. ===Dark Avengers=== After Osborn escaped the Raft, he decide to create a new H.A.M.M.E.R. organization and recruit an new team of Dark Avengers. The boys were placed in numerous foster homes, and when Clint turned 13, the boys ran away from one of them. The boys eventually came across a carnival. bernard kloss.name: Bernard Kloss
bernard kloss.origin: Bernard Kloss was a paleontologist who hired Gordon Greig to lead him to the Savage Land for scientific study. Even though Greig had no idea how to get there, they accidentally found their way there after being lost in a blizzard. He was betrayed by Greig, who tied him to a tree and left him to die. He was saved by Ka-Zar. Fascinated by the local wildlife, Kloss remained in the Savage Land. When a madness began seizing the residents of the Savage Land, Kloss theorized that it was caused by the proximity to Vibranium and convinced Ka-Zar to travel to London to acquire the help of a geologist. Having discovered evidence that the dinosaurs in the Savage Land came from the Sheenarians' home dimension, he accompanied Ka-Zar who traveled there to prevent further invasions. There, he became a prisoner of the Kramen who syphoned off his life energies, rapidly aging him.

bernard lebranche.name: Bernard LeBranche
bernard lebranche.origin: Bernard LeBranche was a member of the New Orleans Thieves' Guild, and a mutant related to the LeBeau family. Nothing else is known of his past. After using the Mardi Gras festivities as a cover for a diamond heist, Bernard noted a newspaper headline stating that eleven people had been killed in the French Quarter by an unknown assailant; Bernard knew this violence to have been part of the feud between the Thieves' Guild and the Assassins' Guild. He was subsequently attacked in his home by the same killer, who was in fact a member of the Assassins' Guild possessed by the alien Brood. Bernard briefly fought the assassin with his powers, but ultimately perished on the figure's claws, his body thrown from his house's balcony.

bernard riggley.name: Bernard Riggley
bernard riggley.origin: Bernard Riggley was the owner of the Brooklyn Badgers, a professional baseball team which had been taken on a twelve year winning streak by their manager, Chuck McArthur. In spite of this, Riggley refused to make Chuck co-owner of the Badgers. In retaliation, during the Badgers' thirteenth game, McArthur proceeded to sabotage the game as the Black Toad, during which he murdered the team's pitcher. Two of the on-lookers were Pvt. Steve Rogers and James Buchanan Barnes, who investigated the murder as Captain America and Bucky. After the two heroes were willing to act as substitute players to expose the Black Toad, Riggley attempted to tell them of his suspicions about McArthur, only to be murdered by a poisoned dart. Nevertheless, Cap captured the Toad and unmasked him as McArthur, who committed suicide to escape punishment.

bernardo latta.name: Bernardo Latta
bernardo latta.origin: Bernardo Latta was a man who lived in the town of Tamora on the Italian island of Sicily. After his sister Sophia was assaulted by a man, Bernardo killed the man in revenge, resulting him in being convicted of murder and spending 10 years in prison. During Bernardo's time in prison, Sophia had become a vampire and mentally took control of several men in town to feed on their blood but apparently made sure not to consume enough to where they died. After being released from prison, Bernardo returned to Tamora and learned about the multiple men that had been seen in the company of Sophia. So, he killed them all the men as they drank in a tavern to avenge Sophia's honor and even went as far as to kill a waitress who implied Sophia slept around. He later visited some old Roman ruins where the waitress said his sister partook in all night activities. However, Bernardo learned too late Sophia wasn't being defiled since she was now a vampire and feasted on his blood for killing her "friends".

bernie.name: Bernie
bernie.origin: A Jewish woman, Bernie Rosenthal is renowned as one of the most talented glass blowers in the New York metroplex. Rosenthal is the former owner and operator of Rosenthal's Glass Menagerie in Greenwich Village, New York, along with her partner Ann Brennan. She once held a long-standing romantic relationship with Steve Rogers. They were, at one time, engaged to be married. She leased an apartment directly below Rogers' when both resided at the same Brownstone Apartment complex (owned by Anna Kapplebaum) at 569 Leaman Place, Brooklyn Heights, NY. After being forced to close the glass shop due to a rise in the rent, Bernie left New York and Steve Rogers to attend law school at the University of Wisconsin (Madison). She has since become a successful lawyer and has maintained a friendship with Rogers. More recently she has served as the attorney for Bucky Barnes who was charged by the Federal Government for his former actions as the "Winter Soldier".

bernie lachenay.name: Bernie Lachenay
bernie lachenay.origin: Little is known of Manbot's previous life, except that his name was Bernie Lachenay, and that he worked for Department H before being bonded with a Box robot. The Department merged him with what they had made of the Box Armor. According to an omniscient narrator, little remains of Bernie's human personality, and he may have no sense of humor. A sight that would reportedly cause Bernie to laugh had no apparent effect on Manbot. He did not even crack a smile. thumb|left During the newly reassembled Alpha Flight's first few missions, Manbot secretly recorded the activities for later study back at the Department H. After the restructuring of the Department that followed the apparent death of a high-ranking official, Manbot was no longer utilized in such a covert manner and has since been reassigned to the training team Beta Flight.

berserker primitive.name: Berserker (Primitive)
berserker primitive.origin: Born to a group of primitive men, the Berserker was the sole survivor in a battle between his own tribe and an opposing tribe. Fleeing his pursuers, he escaped into "The Cave of Glowing Walls", an area feared by his enemies. Inside, he found the remains of those who had entered before him, but unlike the rest, he managed to go farther into the cave, growing weaker with each step. Eventually he stumbled down a cliff inside the cave but he emerged a few hours later, having gained immense powers and an insane fury. The first to fall before him were those who had vanquished his tribe. From there, he continued killing any who he came across, eventually being known as the Berserker. Centuries after gaining his powers, he came to the ancient city of Sumer where a nobleman hired him to be his private guard, appointing him the task of killing the town's rulers. After these murders he began hiring himself out to the highest bidder, eventually being employed by the pharaohs of Egypt and Alexander the Great. thumb|left|Berserker immediately after transformation After these countless battles, his reputation somehow came to the attention of an unnamed alien race. While he at first feared them, the rush of battle quickly brought him joy and he served various alien races as he had served various humans. As on Earth, he was rewarded for his bloodlust, often with special alien weaponry. Eventually he returned to Earth, joining the Roman Legions. In this role, he came to the attention of the Earth Lords, who feared that Rome would come to conquer all humanity. After several failed attempts, the Earth Lords caused the , entombing the Berserker within the lava, but not killing him. Knowing he would return some day, the Shadow-Lord was appointed to watch the Earth until his return. Revived in the present-day, the Shadow-Lord was also awakened. Viewing him as a threat, the US Navy and the Avengers fought the Shadow-Lord, leading to his death. After learning of him, the Avengers and their ally Rachel Palmer, sought out his path of destruction and attempted to oppose him. During the initial battle, Rachel was captured by the Berserker. After having her change into a Roman-esque dress, he noticed she wore a pendant kept by the Shadow-Lord and took it for himself. In the following battle with the Avengers, Wonder Man realized that the pendant must be a key to the Shadow World, but was initially knocked aside. After defeating the rest of the team and attempting to crush the Wasp, Wonder Man attempted a second strike and was successful in joining the two halves of the pendant. The Wasp then hit the pendant with her sting, shattering the pendant and sucking the Berserker into the Shadow World. The Berserker then somehow returned to fight against the thing with the Champion of the Universe, Terrax the Tamer and the Faceless One.

bert and ollie.name: Bert and Ollie
bert and ollie.origin: Bert the Ventriloquist was in show business in the 1940s with his dummy Ollie. In 1946 he was literally booed off stage and fired by his employer Hal Peters. Bert, oblivious to how horrible he was, told Peters that he would eventually come crawling back to him. Bert then decided to turn to crime, using his technical know-how to convert Ollie into a remote control robot. He then used Ollie to break into wealthy homes through small spaces, making a great deal of money and attracting the attention of the Human Torch and Toro to begin investigating. While on patrol, the two heroes spotted Bert as Ollie was committing another robbery. Having seen Bert's act, they recognized him and managed to chase him down. However, Ollie knocked the two heroes out with a bus stop sign and they managed to escape. Bert then followed the heroes as they attempted to track him down. The Torch and Toro split up to search for Hal Peters. In order to trip up their search, Bert dressed Ollie up like Toro and sent him to fight a random stranger on the street and then flee. Thinking he was really attacked by Toro, the man pressed charges and Toro was arrested for assault. When the Torch eventually found Hal Peters, they used radio announcer Sammy Starbrite to trick Bert into making a meeting with Hal to renew his ventriloquism career. Bert invited Hal to his place, but when the Torch attacked he trapped them, spraying the Torch with a chemical "32O" that retards fire. He then placed the two men on a hydrollic press while watching their next robbery. By this point, public pressure forced the authorities to let Toro free. Toro then went after Bert and Ollie but was also doused with 32O. But before Bert could shoot Toro, the Torch and Hal broke free and messed with Ollie's control. Bert then went after his creation, distracting him long enough for the Torch to arrive on the scene. The Torch and Toro then easily captured Bert, destroying Ollie in the process. Bert's subsequent fate is unknown.

bert gilmore.name: Bert Gilmore
bert gilmore.origin: Bert Gilmore began his software company, Gilsoft Games, with a few programmers. Over the years it grew, to the point where several of their games were on the cusp of massive success. Hiring lawyers Matt Murdock, Foggy Nelson, and Rosalind Sharpe to ensure that Gilsoft held all of the rights to the games its programmers developed, Gilbert was met with some resistance by his employees, as well as Murdock. Following Murdock, who had left Gilsoft in pursuit of programmer Angela Bradford, he came across a battle between Spider-Man and Daredevil. Spotting Bradford, he knocked her down and stole her MVRI, sensing profit. Conjuring up a horde of illusory monsters to stop the heroes from pursuing him, he was nonetheless tripped up by Daredevil. After witnessing Spider-Man smash the purloined MVRI, Gilmore was hauled away by the police, vowing to sue both Bradford and Spider-Man.

bert packer.name: Bert Packer
bert packer.origin: Teenage brothers Bert and Hubie Packer were criminals who travelled to Medina County, Ohio, with the idea of looting the Bar with No Name. Several supervillains had been killed in a massacre there, and some of their specialized weapons had not been found yet. The mercenary group Wild Pack was hired to stop them, and they sent Rocket Racer, but the Packers, known collectively as the Packrats, got rid of the Racer temporarily, found the Bar and got the Bird-Man and Cyclone's suits. With the help of sympathetic sheriff Andy Taylor, the Racer recovered and tracked the Packrat to the Bar. Although the Packers were suited, the Racer first incapacitated Hubie (the Bird-Man), then defeated Bert (the Cyclone). Hubie recovered enough to pick a sword in his second wind, but the sheriff got him down. Both criminals were arrested.

bes.name: Bes
bes.origin: Bes is a member of the Ennead, an extra-dimensional race of beings once worshiped by the people of Ancient Egypt, and the god of luck and probability. He was possibly the brother of Khonshu and Montu, sons of Ammon-Ra and Amaunet, as was Ptah. Bes met the Earth Force when they tricked Grog into taking them to Seth's dimension. But Seth had already begun his assault of Asgard itself, and Balder had no choice but to use the Celestial Siphon to drain Thor's powers into himself, leaving Thor helpless before Grog and Seth's army. Thor, Hogun, Black Knight, Earth Lord, and Skyhawk were all trapped inside the Black Pyramid being tortured by Grog. Whilst imprisoned they meet a shadowy figure. They fought their way through the Black Pyramid and found that the secret to Seth's power was he had imprisoned Bes, forcing him to bend luck to his side. Bes led Thor to an astonishing discovery: the imprisoned Odin. thumb|left|250px|Thor Odinson (Earth-616)|Thor meets Bes In Asgard, the forces of life and the forces of death clashed in fierce combat. Seth challenged Balder to single combat, and of course, cheated. Balder fell and the power of Thor returned to him. The manacles holding Odin were really power dampeners, hiding his presence from Surtur. Odin imparted all his power to Thor to fight the fire demon when he arrived. Thor battle Surtur across time and space. Karnilla rescued Balder before Seth's final blow could be struck, and he convinced her to help Asgard. Meanwhile, Odin fought Seth, and with the help of the cursed Black Knight, the serpent god was defeated. Earth Force was restored by the Egyptian gods and returned to Earth.

beta red.name: Beta Red
beta red.origin: Though Apocalypse was defeated by the X-Men, a decade later, a new tyrant rose in the form of Weapon Omega, the transformed X-Man known as Weapon X. Beta Red was a member of the Black Legion, a group of merciless killers in service to Weapon Omega. With the world once more thrown into chaos and ruin, only the strong survived, and the X-Men were decimated. When the X-Force from Earth-616, arrived, the X-Men tried to assist them in rescuing the mutant known as Gateway. Their mission to the prison known as the Sky was a trap, however, and the Black Legion was waiting for them when they arrived. In the moment before they attacked, Beta Red caressed Demon-Ock with her tentacles, and then gave chase along with the rest of her teammates when X-Force and the X-Men fled. Weapon Omega himself stood in their path, and roasted his own daughter alive with his newfound power. Jean Grey was captured by Weapon Omega; forced to do battle, the mutants fought against Beta Red and her brethren. Beta Red attacked Sabretooth, snaring him in her coils, but as the mutants gained the upper hand, Creed gashed open her face with his claws. Later, Beta Red participated in the Black Legion's assault on The Vestry, one of the last bastions of humankind. During the opening moments of the attack, she impaled a young girl's father on her tentacle, smiling as he died. It's unknown if she survived the battle.

beta beast.name: Beta-Beast
beta beast.origin: The Beta-Beast is an alien monster from a distant planet, captured and augmented by the warlords of Beta, an extra-terrestrial species that employed war monsters in their aeons-old struggle against the Megan warlords. The most powerful of their monsters, the Beta-Beast was still not equal to the challenge posed by the Megans' ultimate weapons: the Mega-Monsters. Unable to confront the Megans directly, the Betans moved the Beta-Beast to their base on Earth's Moon, and soon pitted it against Godzilla in an attempt to determine if the Earth monster might be powerful enough to stand against the imminent arrival of the Mega-Monsters. Based on Godzilla's swift destruction of the Beta-Beast, the Betans were somewhat reassured that Godzilla might indeed be able to overcome their mutual enemies.

beth seton.name: Beth Seton
beth seton.origin: In Mesquite Valley, Tex Taylor and Alkali Ike got involved in a murder mystery involving three outlaws and hidden loot. In investigating the circumstances they came to the aid of Beth Seton, whose father John was one of the original outlaws. John, remorseful of his involvement in the robbery, had re-mortgaged his ranch and paid back his share of the stolen money before being murdered. Tex and Alkali helped Beth recover the rest of the loot and gunned down the last surviving outlaw, now the sheriff, so that they could recover the money and save the ranch.

beth smith.name: Beth Smith
beth smith.first_appearance: Amazing Spider-Man: Skating on Thin Ice Vol 1 1
beth smith.origin: thumb|left|150px Beth Smith was a brilliant student from Winnipeg where she won the science fair and would be rewarded for it. Taking advantage of Beth's presence, Peter Parker managed to get his flight to Winnipeg where he hoped to investigate Electro's shady dealings. During the clash between Electro and Spider-Man, Electro's occult partner, in fact the Chameleon in disguise, took Beth hostage, but again thanks to Spider-Man's intervention, the girl was saved and unharmed, but this made Spider-Man suspicious who as Peter Parker followed Beth to the awards ceremony in Fredericton, suspecting that Electro's partner had some interest in it. It was revealed that the Chameleon was looking for the notes related to Beth's science project that she would use at the science fair, in order to use them to his gains, but thanks to Spider-Man's intervention, the notes returned to Beth's possession and the Chameleon was captured and imprisoned.

bethany bellamy.name: Bethany Bellamy
bethany bellamy.origin: Bethany Bellamy is the first mutant ever elected to the position of class president anywhere in New York. After her campaign victory, she was attacked in the school parking lot by an anti-mutant group known as Bio Rights. Her mother, Bonnie, came to Bethany's defense, but was ultimately found guilty of assaulting Bio Rights' leader, Max Hardwell, and sentenced to five years in prison. Bonnie's defense lawyer, Jen Walters, promised to look out for Bethany while she was incarcerated. While giving out her acceptance speech at her school prom, the event was attacked by Bio Rights protesting her class presidency. Though Walters and Patricia Walker easily defeated Hardwell and his cohorts, Bethany furiously confronted Hardwell over her mother's incarceration. Fortunately, Walters was able to talk her down and Bethany walked away from Hardwell, vowing to make the world better for both mutants and humans.

bethany flynn.name: Bethany Flynn
bethany flynn.origin: Bethany Flynn was a young woman who had a relationship with Tara Algren. They both worked for Leonard Crowley's supernatural magazine Midnight Sun. When Bethany arrived at the office one afternoon, she was immediately harassed by Leonard about the Nightstalkers story Tara was supposed to turn in. She greeted "Crawley" and made fun of his dream to be mistaken for a relative of Aleister Crowley and reminded him that he needed her to run his magazine because he had no clue how to do anything. After listening to a message from Tara on her answering machine about the Nightstalkers story, she left the office again to put on different clothes for her meeting with Tara at the Body Hammer Club. She denied Leonard's request to turn this into a date. Dressed in a black dress, Bethany met Tara at the Body Hammer Club that night. When Tara introduced her to Vlad Dracula, she was suddenly turned into a vampire. Kneeling to their sire, Bethany and Tara were present when Blade entered the club. He told Blade neither of the women wanted to be saved and had surrendered themselves to him almost willingly. This angered Blade, who then attacked Dracula.

betilakk.name: Betilakk
betilakk.origin: Very little was known about the past of the mysterious being who called himself Interloper. He was one of the Eternals of Earth, although for unknown reasons, he chose to have little to do with them or with the rest of humanity. However, he was known to be friends with the Eternal known as the Forgotten One. Interloper fought the evil cosmic being known as the Dragon of the Moon many times. His first battles with the Dragon were off the planet Earth, alongside his fellow Eternals. Apparently these battles were on Saturn's moon Titan and Interloper fought alongside the Eternals of Titan. Later Interloper alone fought the Dragon on Earth. Interloper's final battle with the Dragon before recent times took place in the Sixth Century A.D. on Earth. The Dragon had allied itself with Mordred, leader of the forces at war with King Arthur of Camelot. During the final battle between Arthur's forces and Mordred's, Interloper and his allies (whose names were not known, although Arthur himself somehow played a part) succeeded in somehow imprisoning the Dragon somewhere in space. It seemed that Interloper incorrectly believed they had destroyed the Dragon, Arthur and Mordred mortally wounded each other during this battle, and both died. Interloper apparently lived the life of a hermit over the following centuries, having little to do with others. Using his psychic powers, the man named Manslaughter discovered Interloper in the wilderness where the latter lived. Impressed that Manslaughter could find him, Interloper trained him in developing his psychic powers. However, aware of Manslaughter's mental instability, Interloper was careful not to teach him too much.; More recently, the Dragon placed the woman called Moondragon totally under its psychic influence. Sensing the Dragon's presence, Interloper left the Siberian wilderness and tracked the Dragon to the headquarters of the Defenders, a team of superhuman adventurers, in Colorado. There Interloper joined Manslaughter and the Defenders in doing battle with the Dragon and Moondragon. Moondragon cast the soul of Isaac Christians out from the body of the Gargoyle, one of the Defenders, and the Dragon took control of the Gargoyle's demonic body. Finally, Interloper decided to project his own Eternal life force against the Dragon in an attempt to destroy the creature. Brunnhilda the Valkyrie decided to sacrifice her life force as well. Needing mortal vessels in order that their power might defeat Moondragon as well, Interloper and the Valkyrie asked Manslaughter and the Defender Andromeda to add their life forces as well. The two agreed, and joining hands, the four allies formed the "Dragon's Circle" and hurled tremendous power at the Dragon, Moondragon, and the Gargoyle. The rest of the Defenders went to rescue endangered innocents, and when they returned, Interloper, the Valkyrie, Andromeda, Manslaughter, Moondragon, and the Gargoyle had all seemingly been transformed into statues of ashes and dust, and the Dragon of the Moon was apparently gone. Interloper returned via bonding to Will Fanshawe. When the Mad Titan Thanos attacked the Eternal city of Polaria, he killed almost all of its residents, including Betilakk.

Despite his great size and girth, Interloper can run and move at speeds greater than even the finest human athlete.
Despite his size, Interloper's agility, balance, and bodily coordination are enhanced to levels that are beyond the natural physical limits of even the finest human athlete.
His reflexes are similarly enhanced and are superior to those of the finest human athlete.

betrayo.name: Betrayo
betrayo.first_appearance: Guardians of the Galaxy Annual Vol 4 1
betrayo.origin: Betrayo was the most sniveling henchman of Rapskullion, the evil ruler of Evillius, one of the halves of the planet Muscula, which was locked in eternal conflict with Noblor and its champion, Majestar. When Majestar and his allies attacked Evillius, Betrayo struck the hero from behind, causing him to lose grip of his weapon, the Sword of Strength. The sword was then picked up by Majestar's brother, Otherone, who boosted it with the Power Stone in his possession, unwittingly resulting in the complete destruction of Evillius, which caused Betrayo's death and obliterated the entire planet as well.

bettina kaposvar.origin: Bettina was one of the three female "wantons" (prostitutes) that worked the back alleys of Bistriz. They were sired by Dracula and transformed into vampires to live in his castle as one of his brides. The three of them constantly attempted to seduce Dracula and any other male visitor that went to Castle Dracula. She and the fellow Brides tried to feed on traveler Jonathan Harker, but Dracula told the Brides that Harker was his meal and gave them something to feed on instead. While Dracula planned to leave for England, he keep Harker locked up. Bettina and the other Brides taunted Harker and stated that he would be theirs.

betty corey.name: Betty Corey
betty corey.origin: Betty Corey was the childhood sweetheart of Penny Pennington. They grew up together and Betty developed a crush on the intelligent young man, but her father Colonel Corey did not approve of him. The two drifted apart when Penny enlisted in the military and ended up fighting in both World War II and the Korean War. Following the ceasefire in Korea in 1953, Betty accompanied her father to that country in 1954. There she was reunited with Penny, but their reunion was rocky due to the intervention of Sargent Pulaski who was assigned to keep an eye on Betty on base by her father, and who was also trying to romance Betty. When the pair were captured by Chinese guerrilla soldiers still active despite the ceasefire, Penny rescued them using the contents of Betty's purse. Betty remained on base for the remainder of the American occupation of South Korea and was regularly rescued by Penny whenever she got into trouble.

betty crane.origin: Betty Crane is the daughter of scientist Simon Crane. Simon constructed a rocket that allowed him to fly to the Moon. On its maiden flight, he took his daughter and Professor Philo Zog along with him to help explore. When Philo's invention, Electro, was captured by the alien known as Gnorr, Betty aided her father and Professor Zog in recovering the robot by destroying the aliens' fortress. After the robot was recovered, Betty expressed her happiness at being able to return home to Earth.

betty forest.name: Betty Forest
betty forest.origin: Betty Forest's life was shattered when her mother died from cancer and her father unable to deal with the grief turned to drinking and became abusive. Things continued to grow worse for Betty when she fell in love with a man named Wayne. Thinking she had finally found the right man, it was not meant to be as Wayne was just as abusive as her father. Betty eventually came to St. Andrew's and in the counseling of Caitlan Leiber who was fresh out of school at that point. Betty eventually returned to Wayne and Caitlan feeling she failed turned to her other patients. Things for Betty continued to spin out of control and she was hit pretty bad by Wayne in a run down factory they were living in. Betty was exposed to experimental cryo-freeze chemicals that created the Iron Man foe, Frostbite. Betty was transformed into a being who could manipulate cold forces from body temperature to wind. She became Bitter Frost and went out seeking revenge on those who hurt her. She tracked down her father and froze him to death before searching for Caitlan, which lead her into a fight with May Parker but spared her thinking she was a victim like her. Bitter Frost escaped and went out to find Wayne before she was tracked down by Spider-Girl, Caitlan, and Detective Drasco. A fight broke out, causing Wayne to slip out unseen while Bitter Frost attacked the three. However, during a fight with Drasco, a piece of frozen 2x4 broke off and caused Wayne's propane heater to explode, causing Betty's body to heat up and she returned to normal. She is currently imprisoned in Ravencroft while Caitlan continues to try and help her.

betty martin.name: Betty Martin
betty martin.origin: The Angel saves young Betty Martin from two thugs trying to throw her out of a car. As they try to get away the thugs force them off the side of the road and down into a river at the bottom of the cliff. Surviving the fall, the Angel pulls Betty back up to the street while the two crooks try to look for their bodies. The Angel gets the drop on both and puts one thug in the trunk and the other he ties to the front of the car. Threatening to send him speeding to his death, the Angel learns that Betty's Aunt Emma was attempting to murder her and later poison her father in order to claim the family fortune. With the poison being put in her father's dinner wine, Betty points out that it's a half hour before supper. The two rush toward her family home and are eventually escorted by police. When they arrive at the scene, the Angel crashes through the window before Henry Martin can drink his poisoned wine and exposes Aunt Emma's plot. As Emma flees the Angel tries to warn her that the police have orders to shoot to kill, but they come too late and Emma is gunned down by the officers.

betty nestor.name: Betty Nestor
betty nestor.origin: Betty Nestor was the fiancée of test pilot Don Gorman, who in the 1940s invented a jet engine that would allow a plane to travel 1000 miles an hour. When Gorman sought to test the engine in long range flights, his employer Chester Orsen arranged to have them installed in All-State Airlines fleet of commercial airplanes. During this time Betty was employed with the company as a stewardess and was aboard one of the modified planes. This plane, along with 24 others were stolen by Nazi spies and Betty was made their prisoner until she was rescued by Gorman and the US government. Betty's subsequent activities are unrevealed, presumably she and Don eventually married.

betty 6.name: Betty-6
betty 6.origin: Betty-6 was a harem slave of Maestro in the city-state of Dystopia approximately 90 years in the future. She was chosen to be a slave by Maestro because she closely resembled his former wife, Betty Ross Banner. When the Hulk from the present traveled to the future to help overturn Maestro's reign, but was defeated, Betty-6 was forced by Maestro to rape the paralyzed Hulk in an attempt to break the Hulk's spirit. Later, after Maestro was killed, the Hulk was returned to his own time, and Dystopia became a struggling democracy, a pregnant Betty-6 became a librarian in Castle Maestro. While everyone around her assumed she was carrying Maestro's child, Betty-6 admitted it could be the Hulk's instead. When the Abomination seized control of Dystopia, he ordered Betty-6 killed before she could give birth to a child with a possible claim on Dystopia's throne. Betty-6 and several other Dystopians targeted by the Abomination traveled into the past in Castle Maestro's Time Platform to escape. Arriving in the present, the refugees from the future fell in with the present-day Abomination's community of homeless people living in the sewers underneath Manhattan. Shortly after arriving, Betty-6 gave birth to her son, who she named Bruce Willis Sylvester Chan. The refugees (most of whom had super-powers) joined with the Abomination to form the team known as the Abominations, dedicated to protecting the homeless of New York City. In the future, the future Abomination destroyed the Time Platform and stranded Betty-6 and the others in the past, deciding that having them stuck in the past was as good as having them dead.

bevel stonemarrow.name: Bevel Stonemarrow
bevel stonemarrow.origin: Lord Bevel Stonemarrow was the "famous witch butcher" of Brythunia. He claimed that every drape, carpet and bedsheet in his 1,000-room castle was made from flesh flayed from the deadliest of Stygian She-Serpents and Hyperborean Witch-Men. He was seduced and brought to the Tower of Razazel by the Crimson Witch, who intended to use his blood to awaken her dark lord Razazel. After mating with him, the Witch gutted him but saw that Stonemarrow was a liar, with no potency in his blood, like many warriors warriors seduced and slaughtered by the Witch. Nonetheless, the Crimson Witch sensed that Stonemarrow had impregnated her with two child, and nine months later, she gave birth to Razza and Zazella, the Children of the Great Red Doom.

beverly carter.origin: Having born extremely attractive and growing up into a dashing woman, Beverly Carter had too many suitors but felt lonely and uninterested. When she set her aim into handsome Don Maxwell, she found him surprisingly uninterested in her, even when she primped for him. She then discovered Maxwell was the head of a model agency, used to have beautiful women around him, and thus uninterested in that kind of woman in his free time. Understanding that she had never developed her personality to attract men, she instead tried a careless attire and went for conversation with him, finally starting a relationship.

beverly cross.name: Beverly Cross
beverly cross.origin: A former teen runaway and petty criminal, Beverly Cross's boyfriend, a mobster, was busted by Sheriff Morris Walters. Afterward, Cross attached herself to Walters, determined to con him out of everything for revenge. As part of this revenge, she tried to turn Walters against his daughter Jennifer, taking advantage of Jennifer's frequent unexplained absences thanks to her secretly being the heroine She-Hulk. For a while, Cross got away with her plan, even selling Walters's house and keeping the proceeds, until he found she had been intercepting mail from his daughter. Walters threw Cross out, but she plotted her revenge.

beverly sykes.name: Beverly Sykes
beverly sykes.origin: Daughter of a former cop, Beverly Sykes joined the army and fought in the Gulf War, before joining the NYPD. She was a volunteer at Stamford after the incident that led to the First Superhuman Civil War and, after that, Bev and her partner Harry Givens became very dedicated to following the Superhuman Registration Act and bringing the New Warriors to justice. However, after finding evidence that pointed to Tony Stark being secretly funding the Warriors, Bev seemed to have lost faith. They were untrusting of Stark for a while, but after an accident that caused the death of 4 civilians, Stark contacted them and told them their only hope of not ending their careers sooner than expected was to join the new S.H.I.E.L.D. New Warriors Task Force. Once again, things didn't go according to plan and their first confrontation with the team resulted in the apparent deaths of two of the Warriors. The rest of the team escaped, devastated, but the Task Force had managed to put a tracer on them and followed them to their hideout, just as they were about to jump in time. Unaware of what was going on, but unwilling to lose them again, Bev instinctively followed them and ended up 30 years in the future with the team. She was initially reluctant to help the New Warriors break into the Stark/Taylor Building to get a time machine and return home, but she eventually agreed to help them and even saved Donyell Taylor before they returned home.

bhadsha.name: Bhadsha
bhadsha.origin: Bhadsha was the Emperor of the Zn'rx, ruling over all the various clans. He was married to all the Queens who lead these clans, including Maraud. Unlike most other Zn'rx, who are very warlike, Bhadsha actually tried to soften his race's warlike tendencies. Although he is a beloved leader, some of his changes, including trying to reduce the process of succession from an all out clan war to a single bout of combat between all the princes, have not been popular. Queen Maraud, as one of Bhadsha's wives, secretly tried to kill him by adding poison to his bath water. The efforts were almost successful, however, he was saved, and was able to continue to rule, when his mind was transplanted into Prince Jakal's donated body. Bhadsha has also made efforts to maintain relationships with other alien nations and races. He is a personal friend of the Kymellian ambassador to Snarkworld, Lord Yrik Whitemane. He accepted the members of Power Pack as allies after their involvement in the Snark Wars, and saw that they were safely returned to Earth after their abduction by Maraud. Several years after getting his mind transplant however, Maraud caused Jakal's consciousness to emerge again and usurp that of Bhadsha, effectively killing the emperor and giving Jakal control over the Snark Throne. Not long after this, Jakal was defeated and the Zn'rx decided to reform their government from an empire to a Triumvirate.

bhakti gavaskar.name: Bhakti Gavaskar
bhakti gavaskar.origin: Bhakti Gavaskar, also known as Mama-Ji, was an Indian woman and a member of the Gavaskar family of Panchajana, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. She was the wife of Rav Gavaskar and the mother of Paras Gavaskar, also known as Indra, and Tejpal Gavaskar. The Gavaskar family followed the Jain faith. Following the events of Second Coming, Bhakti and Rav asked Paras to return to India. His arrival brought Rogue and Magneto to Mumbai as well, where the family soon became caught up in the events surrounding the Children of the Vault. Bhakti was present at the family's residence in Panchajana when the Children of the Vault arrived in search of Luz. She remained with her family throughout the ensuing conflict and was subsequently present during its resolution. Bhakti's relationship with Paras was affected by the tensions surrounding his return home and his life as a mutant and member of the X-Men. Despite the family's difficulties, she remained part of his family circle during the crisis in Mumbai.

bia.name: Bia
bia.origin: Bia is a demigod and the Olympian personification of force. He wields a mace forged by Cyclopes. In the 20th century, the Titan Typhon banished all the Olympians to the Land of Shades, but Hercules defeated Typhon and restored the gods to Olympus. The gods Kratos and Bia served as bailiffs, holding Typhon while Zeus judged him and then leading Typhon to Hades to serve his eternal sentence.

bianca laneige.name: Bianca LaNeige
bianca laneige.species: Human mutate, with artificially gained powers
bianca laneige.origin: A former business rival of Emma Frost and member of the Hellfire Club (though Inner Circle membership is unlikely), Bianca's company was seized by the White Queen in a hostile takeover. In hopes of getting revenge, she used one of her company's hidden research projects to discover and bring back alien technology to destroy Frost International's hegemony, but only succeeded in trapping herself in a nether dimension where she claims to have "endured unspeakable torments". Returning to Earth after encountering someone with the power to send her back, she found herself in the company of a cadre of insectoid aliens called Blattarians, whom she transmuted into seven humanoid dwarves to help her get revenge on Emma. She had since acquired psychic powers rivaling her old foe's, but unfortunately her attack on Emma was timed during the psychic blackout caused by Psylocke's battle with the Shadow King, therefore she had to confront Emma on a purely physical level, which gave Emma the edge to eventually defeat her. Later, she was forced to repair the biosphere while the kids were taking pictures of her all sweaty and with her makeup running. While she was working a strange vortex appeared and she and Dwarves were pulled in along the bio-sphere.

biceptor.name: Biceptor
biceptor.first_appearance: Guardians of the Galaxy Annual Vol 4 1
biceptor.origin: Biceptor was one of the heroic companions of Majestar, the hero of Noblor, a land that occupied half of the far-off planet Muscula. Alongside Majestar's other allies, Abdomina and Legday, they were locked in eternal conflict against the land that comprised Muscula's other half, Evillius, and its ruler Rapskullion. After Majestar's drab brother Otherone became a powerhouse when he swallowed the Power Stone, he convinced Majestar and his friends to accompany him in an unprecedented assault on Rapskullion's territory. During the confrontation, Otherone imbued Majestar's weapon, the Sword of Strength, with the Power Stone and accidentally destroyed the entirety of Evillius, and the chain reaction destroyed the whole planet, killing every Musculan including Biceptor.

biddy cooper.name: Biddy Cooper
biddy cooper.origin: Biddy Cooper was a female all-American teenager living in Riverdull and, apparently, courting male all-American teenager Starchy Androods. Androods believed that Cooper was droolingly attractive, but he eventually married Moronica Codger. Disheartened, Cooper moved to Los Angeles and worked as an actress in several movies. Later, Cooper decided that her own work was degradingly contemptible, and she returned to Riverdull so she could re-build her own life. Her plan included writing a book and a TV mini-series about her own life. To that end, she decided to cameo in Starchy Androods' four-page special in . The cameo was a success, with Cooper suddenly appearing in Androod's home without warning and explaining her life while the narrator's captions detailed her wardrobe and hairdress. Cooper started working with the Androodses and their friend Jerkhead. They pretended to be typical teenagers performing usual activities such as partying and going for icecream - even if Androods was so old that he needed wig and dentures for the charade. During one of these public meetings, they were interrupted by superheroine Milk, who was fighting a nearby dinosaur. Milk, a teenager herself, took a moment of her time to reprimand the false teenagers for their unhealthy diet. Androods revealed that they had been playing teenagers for so long that they had grown old, and reprimanded Milk for meddling.

biff bison.name: Biff Bison
biff bison.origin: The Skrull that would adopt the identity of Biff Bison was one of the two Super-Skrulls assigned to the Skrull outpost of Kral X following the aliens' botched secret invasion on Earth. When the sons of Kral X's ruler Don Scarpone spread around the planet their fanaticism for a TV series from Earth called the Ritchie Redwood Show, the two princes converted the two Super-Skrulls, and used their firepower to defeat and force their father and those loyal to him into exile. The two princes then adopted the identities of the show's cast members Ritchie Redwood and Bugface Brown and refashioned Kral X into a recreation of the show's setting, the town of Glenbrook. The two Super-Skrulls also role-played, with one of them adopting the identity of Biff Bison, one of Ritchie's friends. thumb|left|Biff's human disguise When MIA U.S.Avengers member Cannonball was brought to Glenbrook so to have a genuine Earther among its cast and he attempted to escape, Ritchie had Biff break character, assume a Super-Skrull form and stop the runaway. As soon as the U.S.Avengers arrived to Glenbrook, Ritchie received them with the two Super-Skrulls read to fight. During the ensuing fight, Smasher hurled Squirrel Girl at Biff, and she kicked him in the face with all of her strength, knocking him out. Following Ritchie's defeat, he and the two Super-Skrulls were arrested by the Shi'ar forces that assisted the U.S.Avengers in traveling to Glenbrook, so they could face justice on the planet where Don Scarpone and his people had been exiled.

biff tallant.name: Biff Tallant
biff tallant.origin: Mark Tallant, the grandfather of Biff, found a gold mine and founded the village of Gold Town. When the mine ran out, the village was abandoned but before leaving the village, Tallant donated the property to the publisher and owner of the local paper Grant Woodrum writing the legacy on a letter. Years later, when the land became fertile, the village was repopulated with a series of small ranches and at that point emerged Biff, the grandson of Tallant, who claimed the ownership of the land wanting to be paid by the current settlers. It was up to sheriff Jim Bradley to prove the veracity of Mark Tallant's legacy to Woodrum and it was even more difficult to find an old copy of Woodrum's newspaper confirming that Woodrum had really existed and not having living heirs, the land remained the current settlers.

big bot.name: Big Bot
big bot.origin: thumb|left The Sentinel nicknamed Big Bot by Ashley Martin built itself from the remains of five Sentinels that had been destroyed by the X-Men, After slightly repairing itself, Big Bot traveled West, scanning for Mutants until it detected Ashley Martin. The Sentinel crashed and was too damaged to destroy her. Since Ashley had control over inorganic material, she was able to partially control the Sentinel and hid it in the barn until the arrival of Hank McCoy and Professor X triggered its programming. It attacked the pair but Ashley was able to overcome its programming temporarily. When it overrode her commands, she grew angry when it attacked, and forced Big Bot to destroy itself.

big boy bates.name: Big Boy Bates
big boy bates.origin: Big Boy Bates was a mobster who never outgrew his childhood. At age seven he developed a taste for lollipops, and committed his first crime by stealing one at age ten. By age eighteen he was purse snatching and as an adult he was a full on robber, never giving up his love of lollipops and other childish things. In 1946, now the leader of a gang, he sent his men to rob the patrons of an amusement park that were riding on a roller coaster. However, among the passengers were the Young Allies who thwarted the crooks before they could complete the robbery, forcing them to flee. Returning to their hideout, Big Boy Bates was furious that they were foiled and decided to go out with is men to eliminate the Young Allies. They attacked the boys in the haunted house but were once more forced to flee thanks to Toro's flame powers. Bates soon captured Bucky, Whitewash Jones, and Tubby Tinkel and attempted to shoot them out of the human cannonball exhibit. They were rescued by their allies while Bates and his men fled the scene, unaware that Bates' bag of jelly beans had a hole in it and was leaving a trail the Allies could follow. Deciding to rob a toy factory, Big Boy soon became distracted with the toys and began playing with them until the Allies showed up forcing them to flee again. Stealing a tandem bike, they attempted to get away but were forced to crash by Toro. Bates assisted in their getaway by tripping up the Allies with his jelly beans, but accidentally dropped an advertisement for a kite flying contest that offered a $5000 prize to the person with the best kite. There, Bates and his men participated in the contest intending to rob the winner of the prize. When the Young Allies won, Bates and his men made their move but were easily bested and turned over to the authorities. Bates was locked up in prison, denied the lollipops he loved so much. His subsequent fate is unknown.

big monk mcgak.name: Big Monk McGak
big monk mcgak.origin: After being sentenced to 99 years in prison, career criminal Big Monk McGak broke out of custody while on a train headed for the prison. He devised a plan to wear a fake beard, and rent out a house where he could lay low. Finding a small town, McGak went to Zero Real Estate, and bullied the meek realtor, Mr. Zero, into showing him a supposedly haunted house on the edge of town. Despite Zero's pleas about the hauntings, McGak was adamant about renting the house. When McGak's beard came off, Zero recognized his face from the newspaper. Attempting to grab Zero to keep him from going to the police, McGak was baffled when his arms went right through Zero's body. Zero explained that he himself was in fact the ghost, and morphed into a massive white spectre. Terrified, McGak ran from the house, and caught the attention of a police car that happened to be driving by the house. McGak revealed his identity, and begged the officers to arrest him. When the police asked the departing Mr. Zero what caused McGak's reaction, Zero replied that it may have been McGak's conscience.

big murder.name: Big Murder
big murder.origin: Spider-Man and Wolverine were about to attack each other, but two figures froze time. One figure was tall and carried a baseball bat with diamonds, while the other was small. The short figure asked the tall one why they couldn't let Spider-Man and Wolverine kill each other. The tall one replied that the Big Man didn't want that and that Spider-Man and Wolverine were linked in a way that only the diamonds on his bat understood. The tall one hit Spider-Man and Wolverine with his bat, throwing them through time. The names of the two individuals were revealed to be Czar and Big Murder. Logan entered the bank vault, but was confronted by Czar and Big Murder. He woke up from the impact and was confronted by Czar and Big Murder. The Minutemen had arrived and grabbed Mojo, Czar and Big Murder but missed the three.

big nick.name: Big Nick
big nick.origin: Big Nick was a racketeering gangster. When one of his men, Danny, fell in love with a girl and decided he wanted to leave the racket and become an honest man, Nick didn't accept it, also because he feared that when Danny turned himself in he would also rat out all the crimes of his dealings to the police, so in the middle of the night and under a storm he decided to reach Danny and for this he took a bus which, apart from the driver, was completely empty. While he was sitting, a stranger suddenly appeared next to him and, even against Big Nick's wishes, began to tell him the story that represented everything that would soon happen. Not giving weight to this story, Nick arrived in Plainsville, got off the bus and met Danny and pulling out his gun was about to shoot him when Danny pounced on him. During the fight a gunshot went off that killed Big Nick and everything corresponded exactly to what the stranger on the bus had told him.

big rock.name: Big Rock
big rock.origin: Big Rock worked for Maggia leader Top Man, apparently as his personal bodyguard and participated in the Top Man's attempt to evict the Fantastic Four from the Baxter Building. Big Rock wore advanced armor under his street clothes and carried a high-tech gun. While Top Man briefed his men in a restaurant, he had Big Rock demonstrate the technology by giving the gun to fellow minion Gimlet and letting Gimlet shot at Big Rock himself; Big Rock was unfazed due to his armor. Possibly Big Rock participated in an attempted assault to the Baxter Building, in which the Top Man was apprehended.

big sutton.name: Big Sutton
big sutton.origin: Big Sutton was the leader of a racketeering operation during the 1940s. In the summer of 1942, he had hired Tony Conville to help him in an insurance fraud scheme. To this end, they plotted to have a set of jewels that were going to be displayed by a showgirl to be stolen so that they could split the insurance money. To this end, Conville had the model replaced with another woman who would help them out. However, when the Connors woman attempted to blackmail Tony with letters he had written to her, he had her killed, murdered her roommate, and destroyed the letters. This not only attracted the attention of the police, but also that of comic book writer Red Skeleton who decided to try and solve the murder as inspiration for a comic story. Conville had Skeleton captured and brought him to Big Sutton's office. Furious about the murders, as it created too many unnecessary complications to their plot, Big Sutton was about to execute both Skeleton and Conville when Red's friend Deena Drayson came to the rescue. Holding Sutton at gun point long enough for Red to knock him and his men out. Big Sutton was turned over to the authorities, his subsequent fate is unknown.

big is small.name: Big-Is-Small
big is small.origin: "Big-Is-Small" was one of the archetypal beings from the Fourth Cosmos who formed the templates of heroes and villains seen in future iterations of the Multiverse, notably the Seventh/Eighth Cosmos. When the Fourth Cosmos was visited by the Defenders, he was seen fighting during the battle between the forces of Of-Past and Of-Future. He then joined with the other archetypes to fight Carlo Zota and What-Must-Be. Following the Fourth Cosmos' end, the archetypes joined with the Sentience of the Fourth Cosmos, later known as the Queen of Nevers, in exploring the Mystery.

biggs.name: Biggs
biggs.origin: Biggs was the cat pet of Shannon Sugarbaker's ex-boyfriend, Claude. To spite him, she kidnapped Biggs and turned it into a cyborg to make it a specimen suitable to be hunted for her amusement. Claude hired the private eye Howard the Duck to find Biggs. Due to his inability to tell cats apart, Howard mistook Nancy Whitehead's cat Mew for Biggs and abducted it. Nancy's friend, Squirrel Girl pursued Howard, and cleared up the cat's identity. Before they could continue together the search for Biggs, Howard was kidnapped by Kraven the Hunter, who had been hired by Sugarbaker to obtain other anthropomorphic animals, and brought him to her mansion in upstate New York. thumb|left|Bigg's original robotic implants Howard, Biggs and the other prisoners of Sugarbaker were joined by Squirrel Girl, who had tracked down Howard but failed to rescue him, in a hunt throughout Sugarbaker's immense garden, where they were hunted by her, using cosplay ersatz weaponry. When the prisoners were escaping Sugarbaker, Howard recognized Biggs. Biggs was one of the last of the hunted to be caught, and he was taken with the rest back to the mansion to then be hunted again later. Howard and Squirrel Girl managed to find a tunnel back to the mansion and outfited Howard with some of the knock-off weaponry to confront Sugarbaker. While Howard fought Sugarbaker, Squirrel Girl freed the other inmates, who joined the fight until the villain was knocked unconscious. Howard had Tony Stark shrink down Biggs's robotic implants to appear more similar to a normal cat, but Claude was still freaked out by his cat's new appearance and rejected it. Thus, Howard decided to keep Biggs.

biggs prime.name: Biggs-Prime
biggs prime.origin: Biggs-Prime was the pet cat of the Sparkitect Jho. When Jho and his partner Chipp worked together in subtly influencing the events of Howard the Duck's life, it seems they took inspiration from Biggs-Prime when they introduced the cyborg cat Biggs to Howard's life. When Chipp and Jho flew to the Earth to confront the villain who had hired them to control Howard's life, Jho left Biggs-Prime in the care of fellow Sparkitect Air-Icka. Jho eventually returned to Sparkitron in order to amend his wrongs, and Air-Icka apparently returned him Biggs. With his arrest at the hands of his superiors being imminent, Jho decided to give Biggs-Prime to the Iron Punisher so Biggs could be taken care of and the presence of the cat could calm down the robot's murderous tendencies.
biggs prime.bio: Biggs-Prime was the pet cat of the Sparkitect Jho. When Chipp and Jho flew to the Earth to confront the villain who had hired them to control Howard's life, Jho left Biggs-Prime in the care of fellow Sparkitect Air-Icka. Jho eventually returned to Sparkitron in order to amend his wrongs, and Air-Icka apparently returned him Biggs. With his arrest at the hands of his superiors being imminent, Jho decided to give Biggs-Prime to the Iron Punisher so Biggs could be taken care of and the presence of the cat could calm down the robot's murderous tendencies.

bigheadpool.name: Bigheadpool
bigheadpool.species: Clone of Deadpool that was created by Hot-Pants Zeus
bigheadpool.origin: Bigheadpool was one of the many clones of Deadpool made by a bored Zeus of an alternate universe from the samples of Deadpool's urine on the purpose of making them fight each other. At an unknown point Bigheadpool (or an alternate) was killed by Dreadpool. His corpse was seen by Deadpool-616 when he went to confront and kill Dreadpool.

bigshot.name: Bigshot
bigshot.origin: Bigshot was a crime boss who was almost captured by Spider-Man. In order to prevent the intrusion of Spider-Man, Bigshot kidnapped Sandra, the daughter of Sandman to force him to work for Bigshot and kill Spider-Man. Bigshot's plan failed, however, thanks to Spider-Man who saved the daughter of Sandman and together they defeated Bigshot and his henchmen.
